de/ 'di lta ste/ lha'i khang khyim dang / gzhal med khang la sogs pa dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang / bud med dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa mngon par sprul nas bdag kyang yongs su spyod cing gzhan dag la yang sbyin par byed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de nyid kyis sngags de bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du gzhan gyis byas pa la gzhan yongs su spyod do/ /'jam dpal gcig byed pa la mang po yongs su spyod pa'i rnam grangs yod de/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'am zhing pa bzhin no/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di 'dor ba ni su gzhan du 'gro ba ni su zhes gang smra ba ni/ 'jam dpal gang gi tshe sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs 'dus ma byas kyi khams la gnas pa de'i tshe de 'jig rten 'di yin no/ /gang gi tshe sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs de nyid 'dus ma byas kyi khams la gnas par 'gyur ba de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten 'di 'dor zhing / 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro'o zhes 'dogs te/ /'di ni chos nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag gi tshig bla dgas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid ni 'dus ma byas kyi khams su rnam par gnas te/ de ni nam yang 'dus byas kyi dri mas mi gos so/ /'di lta ste/ dper na rdo rje ni 'dam rdzab kyi rnyog pa'i dri ma'i skyon thams cad kyis mi gos so/ /de bzhin du chos nyid de yang 'dus byas kyi skyon thams cad kyis mi gos so/ /'jam dpal byis pa so so'i skye bo'i 'dus byas kyi khams su gtogs pa dag ni nyon mongs pa can gyi rgyud du lhung ba/ ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa las byung ba'i sems pas srid par skye ba rnams nyon mongs pa can rnam par sgrub bo/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas te/ 'du byed kyi tshogs 'di 'gags pa'i tshe lha'o snyam mam/ mi'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal nyid rgyud de'i rjes su 'brel to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na rab tu phyis pa'i me long gi dkyil 'khor la bzhin blta ba'i mi ni bdag gi bzhin yon tan khyad par can 'di lta bus bzang ngo zhes sam/ mi bzang ngo

zhes rtog par byed kyis de dang tha dad pa yang ma yin tha dad pa ma yin pa'ang ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang 'khrul pa'i phyir sems la ngar 'dzin pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal mthong ba'i 'bras bu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gsang sngags rnams kyis dug dang rims la sogs pa sel ba'o/ /tshe 'di ma yin pa'i 'bras bu gang zhe na/ mngon sum dang / rtog pa'i dra ba dang bral ba bsam gtan rtogs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa ste/ rjes su dpag pa dang dpag par bya ba'i rtog ge'i yul las yang dag par 'das pa yid ches pa'i lung gis grub pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / rigs pa dang ldan pa dang / rang gis myong ba'i rnam pa ni 'bras bu bstan te/ 'di ni tshe 'di ma yin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang drag shul spyod pa'i las smros shig ces gang smras pa ni bya dgos par 'gyur bas na khro bo nyid brtsam par bya ste/ zhi ba'i sems dang / snying rje dang / byams pa'i rang bzhin dang / rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la blta bas lha'i gzugs dang rang gi khro bo'i gzugs tha mi dad par sbyor ba dang ldan par byas pas/ me'i yang khro bo'i gzugs la cig shos kyang khro bo'i gzugs so/ /rang dbang sgyur ba'i khro bos sngags kyi ngo bos bkug la myur du brang ngam/ snying ga'am/ mgo'am/ lto'am/ rked pa'am/ byin pa'am/ rkang pa'am/ rgyab bam/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la srog chags thams cad dgod kyang rung / chags kyang rung / rtse yang rung / sdod kyang rung / lam du 'gro yang rung / nyal yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / 'greng yang rung / chu klung gi pha rol dpag tshad brgya na 'dug kyang rung / lha la sogs pas bsrungs kyang rung bdag la me sbar bas sreg blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig sbyin sreg bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba ma zhi ba la ni ma zhi bar gsungs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes thogs pa med pa'i ngag gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / bstan pa don yod par yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung bkod pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na

rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe stobs mtshungs ba med pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa dam tshig chen po'i gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra sa ma ya dhṛ ke /dam tshig gi rdo rje'i gsang sngags smras ma thag tu de nas sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad du dam tshig la 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i sgra 'ur zhes grags so/ /'di thos byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /de dag skad cig de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan snga ru/ /rdo rje mchog stobs gzungs thob bo/ /yang bdud bzhi pham par byed pa'i rnam par bsgyings pa'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bsrung ba chen po stobs po che stobs bcu'i gzi brjid las byung ba'i gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ badz+ra gi ni/ badz+ra shu u la ni/ badz+ra mu ta re/ ba li nam a gra/ ma hā ba le/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ shi lo shi lo/ ṭi lo/ ṭi lo/ ṭa ṭa le/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍi/ ku rum̐ gho na/ shwe ta/ pad+ma mā li ni/ hi hi he he/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ma hā sa ma ya/ a nu ga te swā hā/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ kye ma bsrung ba dam pa 'di/ /gsang sngags rjes su spyod pa yi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /lag na rdo rjes rab tu brjod/ /de nas yang lag na rdo rjes yang dkyil 'khor gyi thabs thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi mdzod smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra a gra dha ra/ a na lo bi shwa sam̐ bha ba swā hā/ rdo rje'i me lce chen po 'bar ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥsarba mu khe bh+yaḥsh+tsa ṇ+ḍi badz+ra a rtsi s+pha ra ṇa swā hā/ rdo rje 'od 'phro chen po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra ka ba tsa bi s+phu ra badz+rī ga swā hā/ rdo rje go cha'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ma hā badz+ra a gra dha ri te dzo dag te swā hā/ rdo rje mchog gi

spyi gtsug gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ badz+ra a nan+ta ga ti hi swā hā/ rdo rje gtsug tor chen po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ta thā ga te/ ā shā pa ri pūr tsin+tā ma ṇi rā dza badz+ra hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje mdzod spu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ta thā ga te lo tsa na dz+nyā na badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje spyan gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ /oṃ badz+ra ā na naṃ swā hā/ rdo rje zhal gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thī ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te sa t+ya dharma pra tiṣ+ṭhi te badz+ra ga pu ru sa ra swa sti bu ha a laṃ kā ra gar+bha badz+ra dzi hwā hūṃ bha ga ba ti/ sarba sa twa san+to ṣa ṇa ka ri swā hā/ rdo rje ljags kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ badz+ra a gra sa me bh+yo bi shwa rū pa dha ra swā hā/ rdo rje sku'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ar+gha badz+ra swā hā/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ gan dha a ba bhā sa na swā hā/ dri'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥsarba mu khe bh+yaḥ puṣ+pa badz+ra a gra dha ra ka swā hā/ me tog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ dz+nyā na badz+ra swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ak+ṣa ya dhar+m+ma dhā tu s+pha ra ṇa badz+ra swā hā/ lha bshos kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ ta thā ga te tsak+ṣur badz+ra swā hā/ mar me'i sngags so/ /dkyil 'khor gyi thabs kyi sngags kyi mdzod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs te rdo rje chen po gsang ba mtho ba'i tog rdo rje mthon po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje lhangs zhes bya ba'i tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i yi ge'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzi brjid kyi stobs zhes bya ba de byin no/ /

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥta ṭa ta ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra saṃ kṛ ta bi d+yu dzi hwā du rdān+ta da ma ka da ha si ta/ laṃ bo dar ka ha ka ha/ tsu lu tsu lu/ muñtsa aṭ+ṭa hā sa na/ dā ra bi dā ra/ badz+ra bak+t+ra/ badz+ra aṃ ga /badz+ra nai tra/ badz+ra shro tra/ badz+ra gh+rā ṇa/ badz+ra daṃ ṣ+ṭa a nu tsa ra/ kiñtsi rā ya si/ pra bi sha badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da yom̐/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa gh+rur+ṇā pa ya ghur+ṇā pa ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dz+nyā ka ra/ pra ba ra/ dhar+m+ma lab+dha badz+rā ya hūṃ kṛ ta swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lhangs zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i snying po gsungs ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje tshim zhing mgu ste rab tu dga' zhing yi rangs nas/ de'i tshe rdo rje me zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /rgya mtsho chen po thams cad kyang 'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/ kun du rab tu 'khrugs so/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab thams cad kyang 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur par snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje yang 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te/ 'jigs 'jigs lta chen po'i gzugs 'dzin la/ rdo rje'i mig las me lce 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur snang bar byed cing / rdo rje 'jigs 'jigs lta chen po zhes bya ba'i khro bo 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba/ kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur pa mig gsum pa/ mche ba bzhi pa/ gad mo rta skad 'byin pa/ lus la glang po chen po'i pags pa khrag can gyon pa/ lag na rdo rje thogs pa phyung ngo / /yang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad dang / yan lag gi tshigs thams cad nas rdo rje khro bo thams cad mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs

can lag na rdo rje thogs pa dang / kha dog tha dad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sgras go bar byed pa dang / lag na mdung rtse gsum pa thogs pa dang / sdang ba thams cad skrag par byed pa dang / bdud kyi gnas thams cad rnam par 'jig par byed pa dang / 'cha' ba dang / rgod pa dang / 'bug 'bug po'i sgra 'byin pa dang / rmug rmug po'i sgra 'byin pa dang / lag na rtse gsum gdengs pa dang / gtun rked nyag thogs pa dang / lag na be con thogs pa dang / lag na ral gri thogs pa dang / lag na tho ba thogs pa dang / lag na dgra sta thogs pa dang / lag na mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / ka na ya dang / mda' bo che dang / 'khor lo dang / lcags mda' dang / zhags pa dang / dbyug to dang / lcags thag dang / khab 'dra ba dang / gshol dang / rnga dang / 'khar rnga dang / dril bu dang / rnga bo che thogs pa dang / gzi brjid can thams cad kyi gzi brjid mi snang bar byed cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig la lta ba lhur len par bstan nas/ yang gtsug tor nas khro bo'i rgyal po 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul las byung ba/ me lce 'bar bas lang long du gyur pa/ thor tshugs can gsus 'phyang po/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bcu'i tshad tsam gyi lus dang ldan pa rab tu 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dang 'dra ba dpral ba khro gnyer gyi rim pa can ri dgas kyi rgyal po'i pags pa khrag can gyi smad g.yogs gyon pa/ bka' nod cing 'dug pa bstan to/ /yang dpral pa'i dkyil na khro bo'i rgyal po chen po gzhan khro bo zla ba'i thig le zhes bya ba lag pa brgya stong du ma yod pa/ mig gsum pa/ mche ba bzhi pa/ gad mo rta skad kyi sgra 'byin pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs 'dra ba khro bo'i g.yog 'khor brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gyon pa/ sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa kun du bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas khro bo rdo rje be con chen po can lto ba spyang

ki'i lto ba 'dra ba/ mig dmar ba/ khros pa dang bcas pa/ an da rnyil ltar sngo ba/ lag na be con thogs pa/ skrag par byed pa drag pa/ sdig pa'i pags pa'i sham thabs can sdigs mo byed pa bstan to/ /yang stobs mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ snyoms par zhugs nas khro bo'i rgyal po chen po stobs po che zhes bya ba lag pa bzhi pa/ skra gyen du 'greng ba mig ser ba mche ba bzhi pa dbyar gyi sprin 'dra ba lag na be con thogs pa lag na dgra sta thogs pa gsus 'phyang po mig gsum pa stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang gi lus me lce 'bar ba'i nang na 'dug pa bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i gom pas rnam par gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ gom pa 'dor ba'i rdo rje chen po zhes bya ba'i khro bo skra bshor zhing gyen du 'greng ba/ gshin rje'i gzugs 'dra ba/ gdong gi dpral ba khro gnyer gyi rim pa can mig dmar ba/ gad mo cher rgod pa/ kha gdangs pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na mdung rtse gsum pa dang / rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri thogs pa/ phyogs bcur blta ba bstan to/ /yang lag na rdo rje rdo rje drag po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud don yod cing thogs pa med pa/ 'jig rten gsum kun du rmongs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa bskyed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las byung ba/ mdog pri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs ma/ rdo rje'i rtags can ma me lce'i phreng bas lang long du gyur pa/ bzhin yid khros pa 'dra ba/ lag na rdo rje'i lcags thag thogs pa/ bka' nyan pa lhur len pa/ 'khor pho nya mo khri dang ldan pa 'di bstan to/ /yang rdo rje rtse mo chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa/ stobs thogs pa med pa/ sems can sdang ba thams cad 'dul ba/ stobs che ba/ rdo rje'i rtse mo lag na thogs pa/ gdong khro gnyer gyi rim pa can bud med 'bring mo'i tshod tsam pa/ lag pa drug pa la lag

na zhags pa dang / gtun shing dang / tho ba dang / gtun rked nyag dang / kha ba thogs pa dang / 'khor pho nya mo khri dang ldan pa bstan to/ /yang rig pa'i rgyal mo rdo rje'i khu tshur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi khu tshur las byung ba/ rdo rje'i rtags can rab tu 'bar ba 'od ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od zer 'dra ba/ mig gsum pa/ lha mo thor tshugs can ras dkar po'i sham thabs can/ lha dang lha ma yin gzhom par dka' ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa bstan to/ /khro bo de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dz+wā la/ a na la sam bha ba/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ hūṃ kro dha swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs 'jigs lta'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā he/ trai lo kya bi dza ya ha ha swā hā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma tha ma tha/ kro dhen du til ka swā hā/ khro bo zla ba'i thig le'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā te nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa kiñtsi rā ya si ha na da ha bhañdza/ ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ṇa swā hā/ rdo rje be con sngon po can gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ma hā ba la rak+ṣa a ba lo ki ta badz+ra a dhi ka ha na bi dh+wa na sa ya hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ stobs po che'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta tha gā te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā ta thā ga ta no dā r+ya a na a ba lo ki te badz+ra mar dha badz+ro ṣ+ṇī ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ pra dz+wā li ta mūr dhi swā hā/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ bha ga ba te badz+raṃ shṛ kha le ban dha ban dha/ moṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa saṃ ko tsa ya saṃ ko tsa ya/ sarba san+di hri ba ra de swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bhin+da bhin+da/ sarba duṣ+ṭa namaḥsarba tra a pra ti ha te bha ga ba ti badz+ra a tsi ba ra he he li ni swā hā/ rdo rje rtse mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/

sarba thā ga to d+bha be/ dzā ti ni tri lo tsa ne/ sarba dharma n+dhir dha ni ki ti saṃ ka ra ni swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pa tāṃ ke badz+ra ma na se swā hā/ rdo rje ba dan gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā he badz+ra mā la ni badz+ra pā ṇa ye ba hu rā dzā ma yi swā hā/ rdo rje phreng ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ku la sun dha ri badz+raṃ gi tsi ta ri ṇi pu ra ri swā hā/ rdo rje rigs mdzes ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a dzā dzā li ni badz+ra tri shū li ni hi hi he he swa hā/ rdo rje mdung rtse gsum pa can gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ā kar+ṣa ya sarba ma bha ga ba te badz+rāṃ ku shi ki ri ki ri/ mi ri mi ri/ he ha le swā hā/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ta thā ga te bā ga tra sam bha be badz+ra daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ro khā da ya/ sarba ku ru ta thā ga ta/ ā dz+rāṃ ri ti ni swā hā/ rdo rje mche ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā sarba dharma pra bhe da na ka ra badz+ra mud ga ra hi li hi ṭha swā hā/ rdo rje tho ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra prā kā ra ta thā ga te bhañdza na ka ku ru ku ru tsa kre ṇa swā hā/ rdo rje ra ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ta thā ga te/ bi skam+bha badz+ra kī la kī la ka ra swā hā/ rdo rje phur bu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pañdza ra ni ka k+ṣi pa ga ga na kham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje dra ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hā sa badz+ra dza la dza la dza la swā hā/ rdo rje bzhad ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bi lā sa la li ta a nan+ta swā hā/ rdo rje 'jo tshul gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha ta thā ga ta ni r+gho ṣa/ badz+ra dun+du bhi hās swā hā/ rdo rje rnga bo che'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe bha ga ba tidz+nyā na ra smis

bhū te ha ri swā hā/ rdo rje dril bu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ro ma ma ni ni ri ti ni swā hā/ rdo rje spu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bu li na khi shi khi ni swā hā/ rdo rje sen mo can gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dha ra dū ti tsi pi ta mu kha gats+tsha gats+tsha ku ru ta thā ga ta ā dz+nyā swā hā/ rdo rje pho nya mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+rod bha be badz+ra badz+ra shi kha bi tsi tri shwa ri swā hā/ rdo rje spyi gtsug gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bha ga ba ti badz+ra ka rā li badz+ra pi shā tsi dzi dzi ri swā hā/ rdo rje sha za mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bsta ka rā la badz+ra ā nan badz+ra pi shā tsa raṃ ku ru swā hā/ rdo rje sha za'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra rak+ṣa si khā da ya sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ bha be sha ma ka ri/ badz+ra tsa na swā hā/ rdo rje srin po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a ma hā badz+ra khaḍ+ga ts+tshin+da sarba ga tsam̐ sarba sa twā nā na ta thā ga ta saṃ ga saṃ bha na swā hā/ rdo rje ral gri'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ta thā ga ta ko ṣa saṃ bha ba bhū ta ba shi prā p+ta swā hā/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra a na la bin+du dzi hwā badz+ra rāk+ṣa si swā hā/ rdo rje srin mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ts+tshā ya ga ta sarba ga ti ta thā ga ta ts+tshā ya saṃ bha ba rak+ṣa sa badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje grib gnon gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā an+ta t+ta ya bi nā shā na/ bi kṛ ta rauṃ drak+shabadz+ra sa twa swā hā/ rdo rje gnon po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ badz+ra ti la piṃ ga la lo tsa na kā la kā la swā hā/ rdo rje brjed byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā de baṃ ga bu ga ta/ ta thā ga ta ā dz+nyā ka ra pi ba tha se pi thā badz+ra sa twā swā hā/ rdo rje lha'i sngags so/ /na maḥ

sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra nā ga mu khi gau ri nī la ti ti nī swā hā/ rdo rje klu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā dha ra dha ra badz+ra dha ra/ yak+ṣa ku la sun+dha ra swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi ka ra badz+ra/ shi kha ra ga ga na tsa ri ṇi swā hā/ rdo rje dri za'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ta na saṃ bha ba badz+ra ma tha na ṭe ma bhi tsi swā hā/ rdo rje lha ma yin gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā kha na dza ri ti re re ṭi ri badz+ra mu kha swā hā/ rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra gau ri ṭi ki ṭi ni swā hā/ rdo rje lto 'phye chen po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā rā ga dā rā yā na na dza li ba badz+ra rak+ṣa mā l+yaṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi pri ya swā hā/ rdo rje lus dmar gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha ki li ki li ka lo ka rā lā ba gra/ sa ra sa ra gṛh+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa swā hā/ rdo rje kī li ki li'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bi dār pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ba ha ba ha swā hā/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā he laṃ gi li kur+da ni ha he ki hi swā hā/ rdo rje 'gro lding ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ha la hu na ra ku pa ra ba dha ra/ dha ra bi dha ra/ bi dha ra ka dha/ ka dha ka thā/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ badz+ra pri ya ka ha ka ha ha ha he he/ kiñtsa rā ya si sa ha sra bhu dza sa ha sra/ ā na na bin+du daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ra/ dur dān+ta da ma ka pra dz+wa li ta ke sha /na kha ro/ mad sha na da li/ bin+du sū ri ta dzi hwa/ tsan+d+ra ā ti t+ya/ mu ku ṭa/ go ti bir tsi ta shi kha ra/ badz+ra ga da ke yū ra kuṇ+ḍa laṃ/ a laṃ kṛ ta sha rī ra/ badz+ra na kha badz+ra aṃ gu laṃ/ badz+ra hasta/ badz+ra tsa ra na/ badz+ra gā tra/ badz+ra ne tra/ nī la badz+ra badz+ra ga ta/ ba ḍa ba mu kha ga ni gam+bhāṃ ra hūṃ kā ra/ ra ti ta sa ta ha si ta lam+bo da ra/ gra sa gra sa pra bi sha ā bi sha ā bi sha/

ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa/ ghur+ṇa pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba satwa/ bhū ma bhū ma/ bhū ma ya bhū ma ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pa tsa pa tsa/ da ha da ha/ ma tha ma tha hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ rdo rje na da ku be ra 'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pra tsa la/ mo bu li bi dha ra/ badz+ra kri ha na kha/ badz+ra satwa swā hā/ rdo rje rig sngags 'chang gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā shud dha badz+ra prā kṛ ti shud dha/ sho dha ya sarba swā hā/ rdo rje rdzas thams cad dag par byed pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ag+ni badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje me'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra a na la/ pra tsa la mau li thid+d+ya dar swā hā/ rdo rje rlung tshig gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+raṃ ga badz+ra dha ra dzi na ā dha ra swā hā/ rdo rje sa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi ra dze badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje rdul dang bral ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā smṛ ti na da da badz+ra satwa swā hā/ rdo rje dran pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pad+ma badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje pad+ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba ṭ+ra badz+rot+ta ma ka ru ṇa a ga dha ri kā ru ṇa maṇ+ḍa la swā hā/ rdo rje snying rje'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā mai t+r+yud ga ta/ sarba sa twa hi taṃ ka ta swā hā/ rdo rje byams pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pā ra mi tā/ gar+bha sarba tra a pra ti ha ta badz+ra tsin+ta swā hā/ rdo rje pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā sarba shūn+ya tā badz+ra ni ta bi shud+dha sa twa/ a ber+ya badz+ra hṛ da ya swā hā/ rdo rje stong pa nyid kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dhā ra ṇī shwa ra dha ra badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje gzungs kyi sngags so/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bo dh+yaṃ ga /dṛ ḍha ā shā ya

sarba bud dha swā hā/ rdo rje byang chub kyi yan lag gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā mārga bi ṣa dha ka dha ka dha ka tsa ra tsa ra swā hā/ rdo rje lam gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā sat+ya badz+ra sa muṅga ta/ bud+dha rū badhar swā hā/ rdo rje bden pa'i sngags so/ /namaḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a be ni ka badz+ra saṃ bha ba bud+dha pu tra swā hā/ rdo rje ma 'dres pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a bhī ṣa ra dwa badz+ra mārga ni da ri ṣa ka swā hā/ rdo rje mi 'jigs pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tri rat+na sarba pa ka/ bud+dha rū pa ṇi da ra swā hā/ rdo rje dkon mchog gsum gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā dṛ ḍha mū la badz+ra bṛ k+ṣa bo dha ni da da swā hā/ rdo rje byang chub kyi shing gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a pa rā dzi ta badz+ra/ dzi ta ri la bha drā nu dz+nyā na swā hā/ rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra rat+nā kā ri swā hā/ rdo rje rin chen 'byung gnas kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pra la ya badz+ra dz+wa dz+wa la dha ka swā hā/ rdo rje sa rmeg med pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bi ba dha ya sarba hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje 'chags pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā saṃ bh+yaḥ/ sarba badz+ra badz+rot+ta ma ka ru ṇa mā ya swā hā/ rdo rjes 'jigs pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā saṃ pat+ti badz+ra sa ma ya swā hā/ rdo rje phun sum tshogs pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ku mā ra badz+ra ha sta swā hā/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā kā ma badz+ra bi la si ni ta ki ti swā hā/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje sgeg mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā kā ma badz+ra bid+yā dha ri ku mu de swā hā/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje rig

sngags 'chang ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā rak+ṣa badz+ra ni ka man+da de kā ma yak+ṣa ṇi swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ma taṃ gi khi ri khi ga kha ri ka swā hā/ rdo rje gdo zal ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ru dhi ra pri ya/ ru dhi ra be tā li/ li hi la ha/ li li gi ni badz+ra ma thi ni ra hi/ rdo rje khrag gi ro langs ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pi tā li ka li mā li na ba mā li lu shu dha/ swa ri he swā hā/ rdo rje ro langs mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dun+te/ badz+ra shī ti ke/ ud pā da ni pā da mā bi lam+ba badz+ra pā ṇi ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ rdo rje khro bo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ku na khi ku na khi/ badz+ra pā ṇi pri ye hi ti hi de swā hā/ rdo rje sen ngan mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+rāṃ gi ku ruṃ ga ni badz+ra tun+de ke swā hā/ rdo rje sgros ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dha ba li/ dha li taṃ gi badz+ra bh+ra ma ri ke swā hā/ rdo rje bung ba mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra sha ba ri/ sha ba ri rū pa dhā ra ṇi ghi ni ghi ni ṇi ke swā hā/ rdo rje sha ba ri'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ba sa na ti ke badz+ra ku sum ha sta/ badz+ra ku su ma sam+bha be swa hā/ pho nya mo rdo rje me tog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hā sa hā sa badz+ra ha san+tu nṛ t+ya nṛ t+ya swā hā/ pho nya mo rdo rje bzhad ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hi ma da ba li ge/ badz+ra ma da ba badz+ra pā ṇi ma nu sma ra swā hā/ pho nya mo rdo rjer ro ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra badz+ra ku k+ku/ ri ma sa mu khi badz+rod bha be au ya kiṃ da n+de de bi badz+ra pa ta ki swā hā/ rdo rje khyi mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba

mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ro d+pi/ la ke hi na dan+di bi ni bi ku ni swā hā/ rdo rje ut+pa la mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra mā li ni khai la na ti ke tsa la tsa la/ bi tsa la bi tsa la/ ruṭ+ṭu la lu ru swā hā/ pho nya mo rtsen mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ha ra ṇa khā da ya sarba du ra ni ba ri ṇi ha re swā hā/ rdo rje sha bkra mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra maṃ ka ti rak+ta mu khi rak+ta ak+ṣi badz+rot+ti kad+da kad+da ma pi lam+ba/ badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ pho nya mo rdo rje spra mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dha ra ṇi dha ra dha ra/ saṃ dha ra swā hā/ pho nya mo rdo rje 'chang ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra kā li ke dra me ti ko /ran+di ka ha ṭa hu ṭe swā hā/ pho nya mo rdo rje nag mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tha laṃ ba bi ga li ta/ ma hā ma ṇi ku twaṃ sa swā hā/ pho nya snyems par 'dug gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra dha ra ka/ nir+da yi da ha da ha/ bhañdza bhañdza/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ pho nya rab gtum gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra la li ta badz+ra pā ṇi pri ya sarba satwa ba shaṃ ka ri swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje rol pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra tsan+d+ra mu khe/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sma ra bra ti dz+nyā swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje zla gdong gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra go na dur+dān+ta da ma ka bi ma la mu kha dza hi dza hi swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje dri ma med pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ba la dha ri si si mi swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje stobs 'chang gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā khe tsa ra/ badz+ra ga ma na/ he ha ha swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje mkha' rgyu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+raṃ ga to ta ra ta ra du bar

ba ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ka ma ka ma swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje 'phags kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+rot+ta ma swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje mchog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra bāk+t+ra du ha du ha swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje gdong gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dan+du ra tsa pi ṭa badz+ra ra na/ si la da ha ri lam+bo da ra dha ra/ dhu ba ra swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje so'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā raṃ dza ya dza ya/ badz+ra ru tra dza ya/ dza ya tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa ṇa swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje khro bo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā trai lo kya gra sa na badz+ra du ha badz+ra pā sha ha sta/ ā na ya ā na ya/ kiñtsi rā ya si/ ta thā ga ta sa ma yam nu sma ra swā hā/ pho nya rdo rje 'jig rten gsum gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsaṇ+ḍa la/ badz+ra kiṃ ka ra ku ru sarbaṃ/ kiñtsi rā ya si bi tsi tra pha ting pa ri te swa hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje gtum po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra piṅga la/ la li ta ke sha /pra dz+wa li ta sha rī ra hā ka dha ka/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje ser skya'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ke tu kiṅka ra dha ra dha ra/ tha ra tha ra/ ka ra ka ra swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje tog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā te ga dhi la ka kiñtsa rā ya/ la li ta be ṣa dha ri/ dhā ra ṇi dhā ra ṇi/ pra ti dz+nyā mu hu mu hu/ muñtsa da ha saṃ swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje dus po che'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ku la ā dz+nyā ka ra/ ra ta ra ta riṃ bi swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje bka' bzhin byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ha kṛ tān+da/ sha ma na bhañdza ka la ha/ pri ya hi li hi li la li ta du sta sarba hṛ da ya swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje 'thab sred kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/

sarba thā badz+ra shi kha ra/ mu lu mu lu/ he lu he lu swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje rtse mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ka ta ka ṭa/ ma tha ma ṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ku la sun dha ra dha ra ha ra ha ra swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje rigs mdzes kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ha la ha la/ ṭa ra ṭa ra lun+ta na badz+ra kiṅka ra swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje phung byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dha tañdza ya dzaṃ ka ra bu tan+ta ra hwa swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje rlung las rgyal gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha ko ti na dza ya/ kiñtsa rā ya si gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa ko ti tiṅga ti ga ta swā hā/ phyag brnyan rdo rje mtha' las rgyal gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsa pa li ke tsa pa la badz+rī ṇi swa ཱ hā/ bran mo rdo rje phyar mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā su badz+rī ṇi badz+ra du ti ke swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje legs kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pañdza ri ke badz+ri ni swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje dra ba mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā rat+na mā li ke badz+ra pā ṇi pri ye swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje rin chen phreng ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra mā li ni da pa la mu khi badz+rī ṇi swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje dkar mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra lam+bi ke swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje 'phyang ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra su ga na ti ge badz+ra gi badz+ra da yi ta ka swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje snying brtse mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā su tiṣ+ṭha badz+rī ṇi badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da yaṃ ga me swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje legs gnas mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra du ku la bhak+ṣe shu ha ra ni swa hā/ bran mo rdo rje du ku la'i ras can gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ

sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ka ra li ke ba rti ke swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje mnyam pa mo'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dza ya ka ri badz+ra sha rī rā ṇi swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje rgyal byed ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ka ra bhi badz+ra a ti sha ni ke swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje bsdigs ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra badz+ri ṇi badz+ra ba dhi ke swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje gsod byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā me kha la la li ta ke sha ba ri badz+ra gan+dha ri swā hā/ bran mo rdo rje tshig 'dzin gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā su sid dhi ka ra badz+ra sā dha ka yi sarba badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā ku ru swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po legs par grub byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā rat+na mā li badz+ra dha ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rin chen dbu rgyan rtse gsum gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi d+yot+ta ma tsin+ta badz+ra hūṃ/ rig pa'i rgyal po rig pa mchog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ba la ki li ki la badz+ra ma ku ṭa dha ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po ba la ki li ki la'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thārat+na ke li ki la/ rat+na ma ku ṭa dha ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rin chen ki li ki la'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā su rū pa mā la badz+ra badz+ra hi taṃ ka ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po gzugs legs kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra biṃ na du ga ta badz+ra dha ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje thogs pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā la li ta badz+ra pu ru ṣa ma hā yak+ṣa rū pa dha ras ra sa ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje rol pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ga dza kar+ṇa badz+ra lo tsa na tsaṃ na tsa

la kā swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po glang po rna ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tra ṭa badz+ra kañdza hūṃ swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po gnod mdzes kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bhī ṣa ṇa badz+ra bhī ma/ badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po bsdigs su rung gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ha ri ti/ sarba tra me pra ti ha ta/ ta ra ta ra swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje 'phrog byed kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hā sa badz+ra dha ra su tā nu/ sarba a rta sa rta ka/ hi hi ri swa hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje bzhad pa'i sngags so// //phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ bam po lnga pa/ de nas yang lag na rdo rje yan lag thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus bu snying las skyes pa kha nas byung ba dag yid dang yan lag thams cad las byung ngo / /de la lag pa gnyis las ni gzhon nu lag bzang ngo / /kha nas ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i sde'o/ /rdo rje cod pan las ni gzhon nu rdo rje cod pan no/ /spyi gtsug las ni gzhon nu rdo rje gtsug byung ngo / /rdo rje me tog rnams las ni gzhon nu rdo rje me tog go/ /rdo rje me tog thod las ni gzhon nu rdo rje me tog thod do/ /rdo rje'i brang las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i brang ngo / /rdo rje'i snying las ni gzhon nu rdo rje sdug go/ /rdo rje'i dpral ba las ni gzhon nu rdo rje zla ba'o/ /rdo rje'i smin ma las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i smin ma'o/ /rdo rje'i rna ba las ni gzhon nu rdo rje 'chang ngo / /rdo rje'i mig las ni gzhon nu rdo rje 'jig rten mig gcig pa'o/ /rdo rje'i sna las ni gzhon nu rdo rje shugs 'chang ngo / /rdo rje'i mkhur tshos las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i rten no/ /rdo rje'i kos ko las ni gzhon nu rdo rje gces pa 'dzin to/ /rdo rje'i so rnams las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i mche ba'o/ /rdo rje mgul pa las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i glu'o/ /rdo rje mchan khung las ni gzhon nu rdo rje'i me 'bar ba'i gzi brjid do/ /rgya ba nas ni

gzhon nu rdo rje gnya' shing 'dzin to/ /de ltar de dag la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje'i bu gzhon nu khro bo de dag lag na rdo rje thogs pa sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i yid dang ldan pa snying rje'i dkyil 'khor las yang dag par byung ba lag na rdo rje'i smon lam gyis snying drangs pa 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa rnams su byang chub mchog dam pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / rnam par thar pa dang / sa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags pa'i lam dang / stong pa nyid chen pos lus rnam par bskyed pa sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa lag na rdo rje'i snying du 'thad pa sha stag go/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra se nod+dha ba badz+ra pā ṇi pri ya swā hā/ rdo rje sde'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pa hū d+bha badz+ra ba hu shu raṃ ga ma swā hā/ rdo rje lag bzang gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi tsi tra badz+ra she kha ra/ badz+ra shi kha rā pi lam+bi ta ha ra swā hā/ rdo rje me tog thod kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ki ri ṭi badz+ra dha ri/ bi shud dha aṃ ga ra swā hā/ rdo rje cod pan gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra mūr+bha a gi ta/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje gtsug nas byung ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ku su ma/ a tsi dra ta badz+ra mu rti badz+ra swa bhā ba swā hā/ rdo rje me tog gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ba ra dha ri/ u ra badz+ro ta ta ma swā hā/ rdo rje brang gi sngags so// na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra hṛ da ya badz+ra pā ṇi pri ya satwa hi taṃ ka ra swā hā/ gzhon nu rdo rje sdug gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu

khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsan+d+ra badz+ra aṃ ga sun dha ra swā hā/ gzhon nu rdo rje zla ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍa la saṃ bu ta badz+ra bh+ru ba swā hā/ gzhon nu rdo rje smin ma'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra aṃ ku dha ri shru tā dha ra dha ra nir+da da swā hā/ rdo rje rna mchog 'chang gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra lo tsa na dz+nyā na tsak+ṣur+da da swā hā/ rdo rje mig gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra be ga dha ri/ ma no dza be dha ra dha ra swā hā/ rdo rje shugs 'chang gi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ud+dha ra badz+ra sa ma yam nu pā la ya swā hā/ rdo rje rten gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dha ra dha ra dz+wā li ta mū rti swā hā/ rdo rje gces pa 'dzin gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra aṃ ku ra badz+ra ke tu sa ra sa ra swā hā/ rdo rje mche ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā saṃ bo dhi badz+ra dha ra pri ya badz+ra gī ti swā hā/ rdo rje glu'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra dz+wa li ta badz+ra mū rti badz+ra dha ra swā hā/ gzhon nu rdo rje 'bar ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā te dza a ba lam+bi ta/ mū rti dha ka dha ka swā hā/ gzhon nu rdo rje gnya' shing 'dzin gyi sngags so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin byed pa lag na rdo rjes rdo rje las yang dag par byung ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yum sgyu ma'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang bskur cing / gnod pa thams cad 'gog pa lus la bsrung ba chen po'i srad bu thogs pa rtag tu ma byed zer bar bdag gi zhes brjod pa'i sgra phyung ngo / /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā he badz+ra shū li ni badz+ra ma taṃ gi a nan+ta mu kha badz+ra hi li dza yan tiṃ/ ru ti mu kha ti si s+phu ran ti swā hā/ mā ma kī'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba

ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bu bi mo badz+ra mā lī ni/ badz+ra a da bhū te/ sañtsa ya sa man+ta shī ti sha ma badz+ra ran+dha ne na/ ghu dhu ghu dhu/ dza hi dza hi mā bi lam+da/ bha ga ba te bā rā hī/ sma ra sma ra/ badz+ra saṃ gī ti swā hā/ rdo rje mtshams kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra ma hā ma ṇ+ḍa dar+sha ya badz+rī bi kra ma swā hā/ rdo rje snying po 'dzin gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra si tā ta pa tre dz+wa kṛ ta swā hā/ rdo rje gdugs dkar po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi ta ta ma hā badz+ra bi da na raṃ ga raṃ gā pa ya swa hā/ rdo rje rin chen ba dan chen po'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā rat+na kū ṭa/ dz+wa li ta badz+ro da bha ba swā hā/ rdo rje khang pa brtsegs pa'i sngags so/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra pad+mod+dha ba/ badz+ra ā sa na badz+ra na da da swā hā/ rdo rje pad+ma'i gdan gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā smṛ ti/ badz+ra dha ra ka swā hā/ rdo rje dran pa'i sngags so/ /namaḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha bo dhi bi bo dha na badz+ra ba ma ba ma ba swa hā/ rdo rje byang chub kyisngags so/ /namaḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha pi ma ti ha ra ka /badz+ra rat+na dha ma dha ma swa ha/ rdo rje yid gnyis rnam par gcod par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ /namaḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje shes sbyin gyi sngags so/ /namaḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha a mṛ ta badz+ra pa swā hā/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pra ba rta ya badz+ra dz+nyā na sā ga raṃ ra swā hā/ rdo rje chos brjod kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra saṃ sa thā pri ya/ bi rā ga ko ṭi swā hā/ rdo rje chags bral gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā shū n+ya tā ko ṭi badz+ra saṃ dha ra ka swā hā/ rdo rje stong pa nyid kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta

tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā sarba dhar+m+ma sa ma tā pra ba ka badz+ra sa twa swā hā/ rdo rje mnyam pa nyid kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ga ga na gañdza ni ta ra shi sha ya ma khaṃ badz+ra swā hā/ rdo rje nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā badz+ra yak+ṣa ṇi badz+ra da de a t+tsi pa ra ṇi ma na si badz+ra mā li ni swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin mo'i sngags so/ /de nas lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbab pa'i tshogs kyis bye ba bsregs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'jig pa'i dus chen po'i tshe 'byung ba'i nyi ma bdun ltar 'bar ba rgya mtsho'i gling chen po'i me'i sgro ltar sems can thams cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs za ba 'jig pa'i me chen po zhes bya ba rdo rje snying po'i mchog 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā phaṭa hūṃ/ 'jig pa'i me chen po'i snying po smras ma thag tu/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de chu shing gi tshal rtsa ba bcad pa lta bu dang / rlung drag po chen pos bskyod pa bzhin du 'gul nas stan thams cad las khas bub tu 'khor lo chen po'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgyel to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la gnas pa rnams ni ma gtogs so/ /lag na rdo rje'i mthus thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad dang / ri rab dang / ri rab chen po dang / khor yug dang / khor yug chen po 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa dang / rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho chen po thams cad bskams nas rnam par tshig ste thal bar gyur pa mthong ngo / /lag na rdo rje'i snying gnas kyang khro bo'i rgyal po 'jig pa'i me lce chen po zhes bya ba byung nas/ gad mo rta skad chen po rgyas

par 'byin cing thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi snying rnams yongs su bsdus nas nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa nyid du gyur te/ lag na rdo rje'i snying gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs so/ /lag na rdo rje yang snying rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas pas gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba brjod de bka' stsal pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po stobs chen ldan pa 'di/ /bstan pa 'di ni srung byed cing / /theg pa chen po'i gnas 'di la/ /gdul dka' rtag tu 'dul ba ste/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis bshad/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de 'khor lo chen po rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyel bar rig nas cher snying rje skyes te mig gnyis kyis ring du bltas nas rdo rje mchog gi snying po dam pa sbyin pa chen po 'dis byin gyis brlabs te/ spyod pa chen po mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyir rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po la blta zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos rab dam pa la rnam par rgyal ba thob pa byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 'khor 'di la dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sgo cung zad cig stsol cig dang / des bstan pa 'di la srog gi re ba thob cing dad pa thob nas rang rang gi gsang sngags kyi snying po 'bul bar gyur to/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la smras pating nge 'dzin la dbang thob cing / /nam mkha' lta bur chags med la/ /kun du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /smon lam rtag tu rdzogs byed pa/ /gsang sngags kun gyi spyod pa dang / /de bzhin gsang sngags bsgrub pa dang / /brtul zhugs dang ni rtags dang gzugs/ /dus dang yul dang cho ga shod/ /de'i tshe rdo rje de rdo rje mchog gi stobs kyi gzungs dang lhan cig tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la byin no/ /

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā e hi ma hā badz+ra ko ṭi ku ṭi la pā pa ka aṃ ku la shi khe ka bi la ke shī ta ṭi ta ṭi/ ko ṭi ko ṭi/ kar+k+ka ṭi mu ṭi ma hā thin dud lo lo/ du ka du ka/ sa ma sa ma/ sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ s+phu ra s+phu ra/ ud+dho ti te/ ha ri piṃ ga le/ tsa ṭi bi tsa ṭi/ dz+wā le bi dz+wā le/ badz+ra gho ṇa/ badz+ra sa ra dṛṣ+ṭa pra ha ra ṇe/ ma ti bhū te/ rat+na tra ya/ a ti ta le/ badz+ra dha ra bi shās ma/ a pra ti ha ta pra ma rda ni swā hā/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'khor de dag la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag rig pa'i rgyal mo rdo rje mi pham pa mes rab tu rmongs byed 'di dran par gyis shig dang 'dis khyed la phan pa dang bde ba dang srog thob par byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes rig pa chen mo 'di smras ma thag tu de nas dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rjes 'khor de byin gyis brlabs nas mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi pham pa mes rab tu rmongs byed de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras te skad cig de nyid la 'khor de langs nas/ kun du bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la blta zhing tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma ye shes kye ma skyid/ /kye ma sngags shes bsam mi khyab/ /des ni bdag cag thams cad kyang / /mgon dang bsam gtan dga' dang ldan/ /sems zhi tshigs ni ma mchis par/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lhur len gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /bdag cag thams cad mchis nas su/ /cho ga'i rgyal po tshul chen 'dir/ /snying po dag ni da dbul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang lag na rdo rje dbang chen po bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba mang po 'dir rang gi snying po dbul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi snying po'i mchog lags te/ rig byed bzhi rab tu brjod pa rigs bzhi kun du gzhog pa dbyangs dang ldan pa'i bkod

pa chen po 'god pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di las rig byed rnams 'byung sngags rnams dang mchod sbyin la sogs pa'i las rnams 'byung ste/ rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du chos thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'o/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje che/ /rdo rje oṃ zhes bya ba ste/ /byams dang ting nge 'dzin las skyes/ /nga rgyal rnam par spangs pa legs/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po rgyal srid thams cad la dbang sbyin par bgyid pa 'di bzhes su gsol/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi da rā ya/ mau li mau li/ pi hu bi hu swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das snying po 'dis bdag lha rnams kyi bdag po bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs par gyur pa der bdag gi snying po 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na/ des dang por lag na rdo rje'i mdun du lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar thang shing gi yam sreg shing mar dang sbrang rtsi dang lhan cig tu lan khri sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /shi 'phos nas kyang mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na rgyas par 'gyur ro/ lag na rdo rje la blta zhing zas mi 'tshal bar lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na rgyal srid 'thob ste dam tshig nyams pa ni ma gtogs te mi 'grub bo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das klu'i snying po mchis te des na bdag cag thams cad dbang du mchi'o/ /dngos grub stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /dug bsal bar bgyi'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā re re rā tiṃ nā ga le li ri/ phud ta ri dzi he swā hā/ snying po 'di bsgrub pa lags te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam/ mtsho chen por zhugs te lan khri bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de

nas klu gang yang rung ba mngon du phyogs te mchi bar mthong ngam mtsho 'khrugs te de la mi 'jigs par bgyis na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tha mar seng ldeng gi yam sreg shing yungs kar gyi 'bru mar la smyugs pas lan khri bzlas brjod bgyis te de lta na yang 'grub bo/ /de 'gro ba'am mi 'gro ba'i dug rnams kyang bsams pa tsam gyis sel bar 'gyur/ sgrub pa po'i las rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan yang bsams pa tsam gyis bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnam thos kyi bus byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po rim par phye ba mang po 'dir sgrub pa po rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol bar bgyid pa'i rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā yak+ṣa sha ra/ kiñtsi rā ya si/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ de bhī me/ bai shra ba ṇa pri ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig snying po 'di bsgrub pa des ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du gcig pu mchis te/ snying po 'di lan lnga 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ci 'byor pas mchod par bgyis la mtshan thog thag tu til nag po zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar dang bsres pas lan sum khri sbyin sreg bgyis na gang 'tshal ba de stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /zas mi 'tshal bar lkog tu dben par gnod sbyin mo yid la bgyis te/ nyin zhag bdun du lan khri bzlas brjod bgyis na gnod sbyin mo stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /lo gcig gi bar du nyin re zhing dran par bgyis na gter cig stsol bar bgyid do/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'brog gnas kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag kyang dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba mang po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā khi mi si ri sma shri/ pa ri pū ra ya na pra ti dz+nyā man+ta ke swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig bdag gi snying po 'di rtag tu dran par bgyid na de'i slad bzhin du bdag rtag

tu 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des ri'i rtse mor mchis la lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi zhing yungs kar dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang mar bsres la lan 'bum sbyin sreg bgyis na gang 'tshal ba de stsol to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yul 'khor srung gis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bi dha ra dha ri/ gan+dha ri ri si swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig snying po 'di dran par bgyid pa de la dus ma lags par 'gum par mi 'byung ngo / /rtag tu dpal gyis 'khor bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal ba des zla ba tshes nas bzung ste nya'i bar du nyin gcig bzhin me tog gi sreg blugs la lan khri sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /de nas nya'i gdugs la ci 'byor pas mchod pa bgyis la mtshan thog thag 'bras kyi 'o thug sbyin sreg bgyis na grub par 'gyur te gang 'tshal ba de stsol to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po mig mi bzang gis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang bsam pa thams cad yongs su bkang ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā shrī dhi dha ra ya bi rū pāk+ṣa swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la bdag gi snying po 'di rtag tu dran par bgyid pa de'i slad bzhin bdag rtag tu 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des ri'i rtse mor mchis la lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas nya'i gdugs la ci 'byor pas mchod pa bgyis la mtshan thog thag tu gu gul shing gi yam sreg sbrang rtsi dang mar la smyugs la lan khri sbyin sreg bgyis na 'grub par 'gyur te gang 'tshal ba de stsol to/ /ma grub na yang yul gru bzang po lnga stsol to/ /de nas chu dbang rmugs byed 'dzin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir sgrub pa po

rnams kyi don thams cad grub pa mchog 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ku ru tsu ru mu ru dzaṃ bha dza lod bha ba swa ཱ hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig bdag gi snying po 'di rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyid pa de la ci 'tshal ba de bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na nyi ma 'gyur ba'i tshe ri'i rtse mor mchis la lan sa ya bzlas brjod bgyis na rgyal srid dam gter chen po stsol to/ /gi wang la lan cig bsngags te mig bskus na gang la bltas ba de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo gdong la bsngags te bsams nas nyal na ci bsams pa de rmi lam du mthong ngo / /gos 'dod na me tog kha dog ci 'dra ba chur bor ba kha dog de 'dra ba'i gos de dag rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /phyugs chung 'dod na zhag bdun gsum du nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan la sngags lan cig btab pa'i me tog phog par bor na rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na dpal che bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lag brgyad pas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa thams cad yongs su bskang ba'i slad du bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po mang po 'dir rang gi snying po dbul bar bgyi'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā tsa kra dwa dwa bā hu rā dza swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig bdag gi snying po 'di bsgrub par bgyid pa des bsrung bar bgyis la skyed mos tshal gyi phyogs gtsang mar shing mya ngan 'tshang gi 'og tu lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar gzhon nu la ci 'byor bas mchod de mtshan thog thag a ka ru'i bdug pa bsregs la bzlas brjod bgyis na nam phyed dam nang par de la bdag bstan par bgyi'o/ /dam pa gang 'tshal ba stsol te/ zas mi za bar lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na de nyid du gnod sbyin mo mchi'o/ /gang 'tshal ba de stsol to/ /ci ste mi mchi na 'gum par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen gyis btud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang sgrub pa po gsang sngags bsgrub pa la brtson pa rnams la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad

du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po dbul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā pañtsa la pañtsa mu kha pañtsi kha hrīṃ hrīṃḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir dam tshig thob ste gsang sngags bsgrub par 'tshal na des thog ma kho nar bdag gi snying po 'di lan cig brjod par bgyi'o/ /de la bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i slad du bu lnga brgya'i 'khor can bdag de'i drung du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag mchi ba'i snga ltas ni sgrub pa po de'i lus la lha'i spos dri zhim po'i ngad 'bab par 'gyur/ spro ba'i stobs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ bgegs thams cad ma mchis par tshegs chung ngus des dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bdag gi snying po 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngaRa lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ba dmar ser gyi mar zangs kyi snod kyi nang du bzhag ste du ba 'thul ba'am 'bar gyi bar du bzlas brjod bgyis la de 'thungs na gyen du 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /du ba 'thul na thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste ma grub na yang skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na nor 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor bgyis la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bsams nas lan brgya stong bzlas brjod bgyis na 'grub par 'gyur te gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas thags bzangs ris la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi rgyal po rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po mang po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā traṃ gi ni bo de de mā li ni dza ti mi hūṃ swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la bdag gi snying po mchog tu gsang chen drag po dam pa 'di bsgrub par bgyid pa des dpal gyi sgo mo'i sgor mchis la snying po 'di lan drug 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar dug dug dang khrag dang ske tshe'i 'bru bsres pa lan 'bum sbyin sreg bgyis na lha ma yin gyi gnas

thams cad gtan pa ma mchis shing 'khrul 'khor ma mchis bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdag cag gis rim gro char bgyis te rigs kyi bu de bzhugs par bgyi'o/ /yo byad thams cad kyang stsol bar bgyi'o/ /dngul chu dang sman bcud kyis len thams cad kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sna tshogs phreng ba can la sogs pa dri za'i rgyal po rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ma d+ta ma taṃ gi swā hā/ 'di ni bdag cag gi snying po lags te 'dis dngos grub stsal bar bgyi'o/ /'dis bdag cag dri za'i rgyal po zhes bgyi'o/ /lha'i bde ba sna tshogs myong ngo / /mdor na bgyi ba bgyid pa thams cad nus so/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnas thams cad na mchis so/ /ci ste gang la la zhig bsgrub par 'tshal na des thog mar ri phug tu ci 'byor pas mchod pa bgyis la snying po 'di 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na de nas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tha mar du ru ska'i 'bru mar gyi me bus la a ga ru'i yam sreg shing khri sbyin sreg bgyis na de nas de'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /gi wang la sngags kyis btab ste dpral bar thig le bgyis na skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /lag mthil la sngags kyis btab ste gdong la bya bas na skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs pa mi'am ci'i rgyal po rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ti ti li phu swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag cag gi snying po lags te 'dis bdag cag mi'am ci'i rgyal po zhes bgyi'o/ /sil snyan dang pheg rdob pa dang rol mo'i sgra 'byin cing thams cad du 'jig rten gyi khams kun du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du mchi'o/ /lha dang klu'i gnas thams cad

du kun gyis kyang bkur to/ /snying po 'dis ci la yang mi brjed do/ /ci ste gang la la zhig bsgrub par 'tshal na des gcig pu dgon par slong mo'i zas 'tshal zhing snying po 'di lan nyis 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung ba'i sna lnga dang bsres pas dkyil 'khor bskus la ci 'byor pas mchod de/ gur gum gyi sreg blugs lan khri sbyin sreg bgyis na de nas 'grub par 'gyur te mi'am ci'i gnas thams cad du kun gyis bkur cing gang 'dod pa de bgyid do/ /de nas rnam par bdud kyi bu la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ra ṅkā ri bi ṣa ri bi ṣe ṣa ṇi kṛn+ta ni ku mā ri ke ha swā hā/ phu phu swā hā/ bdag cag gi snying po 'dis klu thams cad rang gi dam tshig la dgod par bgyi'o/ /snying po 'di'i ming thos pa tsam gyis klu thams cad bdag cag gi phyag brnyan du 'gyur te 'jigs shing zhum pa dang 'dar ba dang re ba chad par 'gyur/ dug ma mchis shing phyogs phyogs su 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ste rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig snying po 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na des mtsho chen por zhugs la mid pa tsam nub par 'greng ste/ snying po 'di lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na de nas mtsho de nyid nyin gcig bzhin skam mo/ /klu'i gnas thams cad kyang 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi gzugs kyang ston to/ /bgegs gzhan brgya dag kyang bgyid de de la 'jigs par mi bgyi'o/ /de nas mtshan ma de dag byung nas tha mar ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung ba de nyid kyis rgya mtsho'i ngogs su dkyil 'khor bskus la bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje la ci 'byor pas mchod de dug dang nye ba'i dug thams cad las klu'i rgyal po brgyad bgyis la de nas ske tshe'i 'bru re re nas khrag gis bskus te sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /de nas klu thams cad lhags nas dam pa long shig ces mchis na skrag par mi bgyi'o/ /'di skad du phyag brnyan dag tu gyur cig ces brjod

par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du gyur cig ces smras nas mi snang bar 'gyur te de slan chad ci 'tshal ba de bgyid do/ /de nas 'jigs su rung ba la sogs pa srin po'i rgyal po thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po dbul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā kāṃ 'a ri ṇi luṇ+ḍi ni swā hā/ bdag cag gi snying po 'dis mi thams cad kyi gzi brjid dang stobs 'phrog par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad gdul bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mdor na rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum po dag na ci yang dkon pa ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na des dur khrod du du ba 'thul bar zas su sha 'tshal zhing gos sngon po bgos la lag tu ral gri thogs la snying po 'di lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma bgyi'o/ /ci 'byor pas mchod par bgyis la nam phyed kyi bar du bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas srin po'i bdag po gang yang rung ba zhig mchi bar 'gyur te de la 'jigs par mi bgyi bar mchod yon stsal na/ bdag la 'dod pa'i gzugs can gyi dngos grub byin cig ces brjod par bgyi'o/ /des ral gri de blangs nas stsol bar 'gyur te/ de nas lha'i 'gro ba can du 'gyur/ ngo mtshar gyi las rnam pa sna tshogs bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drang srong chen po mes byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang sgrub pa po rnams la sman pa'i slad du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di dbul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā ka pī la dz+yo ti ni ra ṇa da biṅga la lo tsa na swā hā/ bdag gi snying po 'di ni re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa lags te/ 'dis bdag kyang bkug ste dbang du mchi'o/ /dpal bskyed par bgyi'o/ /nor stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na nor 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /snying po 'dis rtag tu bza' ba'i sbyin sreg bgyis na bza' ba

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na rdzas gang gis sbyin sreg bgyis pa'i rdzas de 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na ri'i rtse mor mchis la slong mo'i zas 'tshal zhing snying po 'di lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ci 'byor pas mchod de me thab bgyis la rgya shug gi yam sreg shing zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar smyugs la lan khri sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /de nas grub par 'gyur te dga' mgur las rnams bgyid do/ /de nas sprin gyi phreng ba can la sogs pa rlung rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /sgrub pa po dngos grub bsgrub par 'tshal pa rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā bh+ra ma ra bh+ra ma re/ tsa pa li tsa pa li ke/ he ram bi ni swā hā/ 'di ni bdag cag gi snying po mchog lags te 'dis bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bzhin bgyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung dang mi 'gal bar bgyi'o/ /phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa des thog mar snying po 'di lan sum 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na de nas bdag cag gis de'i bgyi ba thams cad gnang bar bgyi'o/ /ci ste gang la la zhig bsgrub par 'tshal na des zas mi bza' bar lan khri bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ci 'byor pas mchod de ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor lnga bgyi'o/ /kha dog sna tshogs kyi ba dan bdun bzhag go/ /de nas ba dan 'gul gyi bar du bzlas brjod bgyis na de nas 'grub par 'gyur te bskyed pa dang dgag pa la sogs pa las rnams dga' mgur bgyid do/ /de nas skar ma'i rgyal po zla bas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po gdung ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ dpal yang dag par 'jog par bgyid pa dbul lo/ /

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsan+d+ra kā na ti bi shud dha haṃ ga swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi snying po 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa rnams kyi gdung ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa lags so/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na bkra mi shis pa rnams sel to/ /dpal skyed do/ /rtag tu skal ba bzang po stsol to/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des zas su 'o ma 'thung zhing pad+ma'i rdzing du zhugs la snying po 'di lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar zla ba nyal shel lam mar sar las zla ba bgyis la pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i phrag tu stsol te mtshan thog thag bzlas brjod bgyis na nam phyed dam nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe 'od zer 'byung ste byung nas kyang sgrub pa po'i khar 'jug go/ /de nas 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor 'khor nas kun nas 'khod par gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas grub par 'gyur te gdung ba ma mchis pa dang nam mkha' la mchi bar 'gyur te/ bdag gi gzhal med khang du bskal par gnas shing lha'i bde ba dang ldan par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dpal yang mchis par 'gyur te rgyal srid la sogs pa gang 'dod pa stsol to/ /de nas nyi ma la sogs pa gza' thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi snying po gzi brjid dang stobs thams cad pa zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ sgrub pa po rnams la phan pa dang bde ba dang tshe ring ba dang nad med par bgyi ba'i slad du de dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā sid+dha bed+yo da na swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das sgrub pa po gang la las snying po 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na de la nad thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na gzi brjid can du 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des 'bab chu'i 'gram gyi bye ma la mar me kha lnga bus la snying po 'di lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o// de nas mer sbyin sreg bgyis la nyi ma nub kyi bar du bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas nyi ma gang yang rung ba zhig mchi bar 'gyur te/ de la mchod yon la sogs pa 'tshal la gang 'dod pa de blangs la de bzhin du gyur cig ces smras nas mchi bar 'gyur te gang 'dod pa de bgyid do/ /gzhal med khang

gang yang rung bar mchis so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po chu lha klu'i rgyal po du ma dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a pa ma pa ti bi ra dza swā hā/ gang la la zhig byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa des snying po 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na de rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa gtsang ma thams cad la blo mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na rgya mtsho chen por mid pa nub tsam du zhugs la snying po 'di lan 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas tha mar rin po che sna bzhi las klu bgyis la ci 'byor pas mchod de klu'i rgyal po gang yang rung ba zhig gnas kyi bar du bzlas brjod bgyis la mchod yon stsal te ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du byin cig ces brjod par bgyi'o/ /de phan chad gang bsgo ba de bgyid do/ /de nyid du zhugs nas lo mang por gnas so/ /de nas khyab 'jug gis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā e ka e ka /ba ra ba ra/ dz+wā la dz+wā la/ biṣ+ṇa be swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po ni 'di lags te 'dis sdang ba thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /phung bar bgyi'o/ /yams kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig rtag tu dran par bgyid na de'i blo nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /ci ste snying po 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na ri'i rtse mor mchis la lan lnga 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar grog mkhar gyi rtse mo'i sa dang ba'i rnam lnga bsres pas khyab 'jug gi gzugs lag pa bzhi pa bgyis te lag pa g.yon pa gcig na 'khor lo/ /g.yas pa gcig na dbyug to/ /g.yon pa gcig na dung / g.yas pa gcig na dam pa sbyin par bgyis la ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor bgyis te ci 'byor pas mchod la kha nub phyogs su bltas te mchis la

khyab 'jug gi gzugs 'gul ba'am dung sgra 'byung gi bar du bzlas brjod bgyis na 'grub par 'gyur te dgos pa gang bsams pa de thams cad bgyid do/ /de nas yi dgas kyi rgyal po drag pos byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la mchog tu gsang ba'i snying po mchis te des na bdag las drag po bgyid pa'i slad du sems can thams cad kyis drag po zhes bgyi bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das snying po 'dis bdag rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum ma rung bar bgyid do/ /dbang du bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni thams cad pa'i nor lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa gang la dran par bgyid na bdag rtag tu de'i slad bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /yi dgas kyi tshogs thams cad dang lhan cig bka' bzhin du bgyid do/ /'jig rten gsum yang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des dur khrod du lus thal bas byugs la mi mgo'i thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan thogs shing lag na mdung rtse gsum pa thogs te khri'i zur shing khyer la stag lpags kyi sham thabs 'tshal zhing slong mo'i zas bab bab du 'tshal la snying po 'di lan bzhi 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de nas du ba 'thul ba'i dur khrod du ba lang gi lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor bgyis te mdung rtse gsum pa dang khri'i zur shing bzhag la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bgyis nas mi sha'i bdug pa bsreg cing mtshan thog thag brjod par gyis na drag po nyid yi dgas mang pos bskor nas 'jigs 'jigs lta chen po'i gzugs can du mchi bar 'gyur te de la mi 'jigs par bgyi zhing mchod yon stsol to/ /de nas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa thams cad kyang bgyid do/ /de'i slad du 'brang zhing bka' sdod pa lhur len to/ /de nas 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan gyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen

po 'dir snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā po n+ne te dat+ta bhū ta a dhi pa ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol bar bgyid pa ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig snying po 'di rtag tu dran par bgyid na bdag rtag tu de'i slad bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /bsrung bar bgyi/ dpal bskyed par bgyi'o/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des skyed mos tshal dben pa'i gnas su zas nub mo 'tshal zhing snying po 'di lan 'bum bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /tha mar ci 'byor pas mchod pa bgyis te tsan+dan gyi bdug pa bsreg cing gtor ma rgya chen po yang phul/ mar gyi mar me brgyad kyang phul la nyi ma nub pa nas brtsams te nam phyed kyi bar du brjod par bgyi'o/ /de nas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa thams cad kyang bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /sman bcud kyis len kyang stsol to/ /de nas lha mo dka' thub zlog gis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā u ma ye swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni skal ba bzang po thams cad bgyid pa ste/ me tog gam/ spos sam/ lig bu mig gam/ gi wang la sngags lan cig btab ste bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod bgyis na skal ba bzang por 'gyur ro/ /ci ste bsgrub par 'tshal na des bzang ldan gyi snying po la sa cho ga rgyas par nyis 'gyur du sbyar te bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas gza' chen po smin drug gi bus byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir yid rab tu dga' zhing rang gi snying po 'bul lo/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā he ku mā ra dz+wa li ta mū rti tsa ru tsi tra ma ba ra swā hā/ bdag gi snying po 'di ni thams cad kun du skrag par bgyid pa ste gang la la zhig rtag tu dran par bgyid na de la 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /glags tshol ba'i gdon thams
