tu bstod/ /rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'chang la yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ ser sna'i dbang gis dbul gyur pa/ /nor rnams ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ /mdun gyi phyag na rdo rje yi/ /ye shes sems dpa'i phyag g.yas par/ /dzam+bha la ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid sngags kyi rgyal po zlos/ /snying gar 'od zer dag gis ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' bskul bar bya/ /ye shes sems dpas dzam+bha la'i/ /sngags ni zlos pa nyid du bsgom/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas/ /'od byung dzam+bha la bskul lo/ /nor gyi rgya mtsho gang bar 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba btab pa/ nyes pa shin tu phra mo la/ /grags dang rnyed pa'i don du ni/ /'jig rten gnod byed sgrib byed pa/ /thog ser bzlog pa bshad du gsol/ /thog mar mchod rten sngon po brtsig /rab gnas gzhung dang mthun par bya/ /de yi 'og tu 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad lte bar bcas pa bri/ /rtsibs la lha srin snying po bri/ /k+hām̐r+dha/ ts+hāngha/ tsh+hār+ngha sh+har+ngha/ oṃdha/ m+hor+dha/ t+hā+om̐r+dha/ s+bhar+dha/ dbus su sngags mkhan bri bar bya/ /de nas thod pa'i nang du gzhug /thod pa mchod rten 'og tu mnan/ /snying po'i 'od kyis sngags mkhan dang / /lha srin 'khor dang bcas pa dgug /de la thun gyis brab par bya/ /'byung po 'khrug pa'i dus su ni/ /ston pa'i nga rgyal ldan pa la/ /mthe bo dag ni mthe'u chung la/ /hūm̐ las phyag na rdo rje bskyed/ /mthe'u chung phyag na rdo rje yi/ /thugs nas phyag na rdo rje ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu thogs pa spro/ /snying gi lcags kyus dgug pa dang / /mgrin pa zhags pas bcing bar bya/ /mthe bong phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje las ni rdo rje spro/ /bgegs rnams la ni bsnun par bya/ /ba spu'i gshis na rdo rje 'phro/ /nam mkha' thams cad rdo rjer grub/ /yungs

kar rdo rjer bskyed la brab/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /tshar gcad rjes gzung gsungs pa mtshar/ /dbul dang yi dgas gnas las thar/ rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las nor bsgrub pa dang gnod pa bzlog pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin la mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ klu dang gnod sbyin sa bdag gi/ /mdze dang dmu chu ji ltar bzlog /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /mdo sdes ni las kyi rnam par smin pa mi zlogs la sngags kyis bzlog pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /de la klu zhes bya ba nyon mongs pa gti mug shas che bas chags pa dang zhe sdang yang che ste/ gti mug gi dbang gis gnyid che ba dang / zhe sdang gi dbang gis skye ba bdun du mi gtong ba dang / chags pa'i dbang gis chags pa la gnas pa'i lus la zhugs nas mi gtong ba'o/ /klu gdol pa can gyis mthong ba tsam gyis nad bskyed do/ /rigs gsum ni reg pa tsam gyis nad bskyed do/ /klu bran rnams ni steng sgo gsum nas zhugs nas lus kyi bcud za bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ de rnams ji ltar 'dul bar bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das klu 'gugs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sngags 'di gsungs so/ /nā ga bi dā ra ṇā dzaḥ/ nā ga ut+sā da na ya dzaḥ/ sbyor ba gsum la legs gnas pas/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis 'gugs par 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu 'dul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ nyid kyi dbugs las sngags 'di rnams phyung ngo / /tad+ya thā/ bud dha bud dha/ bi bud dha bi bud dha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ha ra ha ra nā ga nāṃ/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga nāṃ/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da nā ga hṛ da yā ni/ bhin+da

bhin+da nā ga mar+m+mā ṇi bi ṣī r+yan tu nā ga sha rī rā ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭa ya nā ga nā ya nā ni/ 'jigs shing skrag ste brgyal bar 'gyur/ /snying gar yi ge hūm̐ bsgoms pas/ /klu rnams thams cad bsregs gyur pas/ /bde ba can gyi gnas su skye/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ de la 'jug pa'i gnas du mchis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtsa bzhi dag nas zhugs gyur nas/ /rtsa rnams na zhing tsha ba dang / /steng sgo mi bde rdul yang 'byung / /rmugs dang gnyid kyi bdag nyid can/ /sha mdog dbu ba lta bu ste/ /rmi lam du ni chu 'od 'byung / /de nas chags pa spyad par bya/ /dbang po gsum du zhugs gyur na/ /dbang po sbrid cing lus kyang 'dar/ /sha ni skam zhing rus pa na/ /de la chags pa mi spyad do/ /sa yi dbang po kun nas 'jug /ba spu'i khung bu dmar zhing 'gyur/ /phol dang sha bkra 'byung ba dang / /rmi lam du ni byol song 'byung / /rgyal po dang ni rtsa bzhir 'jug /tho rangs mi dga' mngon shes smra/ /gnyid chung ba spu'i gshis kyang dkar/ /gu gul nag po bsten par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ nad de 'tsho ba dang mi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa ji ltar lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa/ bsnyen pa mtshan ma thob pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang gla rtsi dang / /'bras bu gsum dang rma bya'i sha/ /ril bu byas la sgal tshigs gzhag /de yi bar du rma bya'i sgro/ /mdangs dang ldan na 'tsho bar nges/ /nag por gyur na mi 'tsho'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de la tshar gcad pa'i thabs du mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sngags dang 'khrul 'khor sman dang bsreg /thabs ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /byang chub rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /dbang bskur dam tshig ldan pa dang / /bsnyen pa brtan par gyur pa yis/ /dang por sngags kyis bzlog par bya/ /snying ga'i sngags kyi rgyal po yis/ /rlung dang 'grogs te

'byung bar 'gyur/ /nad kyi snying por hūm̐ bsams te/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pas bsreg par bya/ /de nas phyir bzlog mnan par bya/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ste/ /zlum po khru gang kha dog dkar/ /kha khyer sor bzhi rdo rjes mtshan/ /gru gsum sor bcu kha dog nag /kha khyer sor gsum rdo rjes mtshan/ /zla dbyibs zla ba dmar 'dra ba/ /khru do kha khyer de 'drar shes/ /zhi ba 'o ma can shing gi/ /gtum pa 'bigs par byed de'o/ /dbang yang zhi ba dag dang mtshungs/ /rgyun bzhag me dang rigs ngan khyim/ /ram̐ las thab dang me lha bskyed/ /zhi rgyas dbang la bdud rtsi lnga/ /gtum pa dmar dang khrag dag dang / /dug dang gu gul nag po dang / /gzugs brnyan dag gis mchod par bya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol zhing / /bdag gzhan phan sogs la zhugs pa/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /me yi thugs kar drag po ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /sbyin sreg de dag 'brel pa yis/ /nor rnams thams cad ster bar byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la zhus pa/ drag po'i sngags rnams ji ltar lags/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pas lha srin thams cad 'dul ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /ṭad+ya thā/ hūm̐ phaṭa nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ /nā ga ut+sā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī la bas nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa rā kra mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tā na tā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kri tān+ta rū pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇāya hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā sa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍa ut+sā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pra ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pa smā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya

nā sha ya/ sar+b+ba bigh+na bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sar+b+ba sha trūṃ saṃ brta bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ om̐ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wā la bha smiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru om̐/ sngags 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha srin thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes ched du brjod pa/ e ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis/ /drag po 'dul bar dbang bskur nas/ /sngags rgyal gsungs pas skrag 'gyur ba/ /ngo mtshar 'di ni shin tu lha zhes pa'o/ /de nas rang rang gi srog snyingaston pa la phul nas bran gyi tshul du gnas so/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las bcos dka' ba'i nad bzlog pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod pa dang phyag byas nas gsol ba btab pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang rgyal pos/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs shing / /dbang bskur ba yang ma thob na/ /bsgrubs kyang ci yang mi 'grub po/ /de bas da ni bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhir bgyi/ /thig bzhi dag dang ldan gyur pas/ /cha chen bzhi ru btab byas na/ /shar gyi cha chen dang por ni/ /bzhir bgos dang po lte ba dang / /gnyis pa pad+ma ral gri gnyis/ /gsum pa lha yi snam bu'o/ /de nas tshon ni dgye bar bya/ /lte ba dkyil 'khor 'od dang bcas/ /pad+ma sngon po ral gri sngon/ /lha snam gnag la rdo rje'i sgo/ /bzhi ni dkar por bri bar bya/ /sgo yi phyi rol kha dog gnag /me ri 'bar ba bri bar bya/ /de la rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /mda' dang phur bu bcu drug la/ /tshon skud sngon po bri bar bya/ /dbus su bcom ldan 'dab ma la/ /klu chen phyed gzugs sbrul mgo can/ /rdzogs par byas nas rnal 'byor ni/ /cho ga bzhin du gnyis ka yi/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du bskyed/ /dang po bla ma'i spyan sngar ni/ /

phyag 'tshal la sogs bdun rnam dag /de nas ye shes sems dpa' la/ /me tog gtor zhing bstod pa bya/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba bdun rnam dag /byas nas ye shes dbab par bya/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum bsams la/ /sngags 'di yang ni brjod par bya/ /ā be sha ya staṃ bha ya rā rā tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ āḥ.oṃdzaiḥ/ de nas dkyil 'khor brtan byas la/ /rig pa'i dbang ni cho ga bzhin/ /de nas sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin/ /rnal 'byor snying ga'i sa bon las/ /sngags kyi 'od kyis ye shes bskul/ /ye shes ljags las 'od byung las/ /snod gyur lce la thim par bsam/ /bsgrub pa'i rdzas kyi bkra shis brjod/ /rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ snying po kun la phan gdags dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gzhug don du/ /gnod sbyin bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /rdo rje chen pos bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /gnod sbyin bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /theg pa che la smod pa dang / /de bsgrub pa la snying nas brnyas/ /sgrub pa 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /de la ri rab kyi 'og na las kyi gnod sbyin gyi lus blangs la gdong bzhi lag pa bzhi yod pa gdong dang po bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags zlos pa/ gnyis pa na rang gi srog snying zlo ba/ gsum pa na me lce'i dbugs 'byung / bzhi pa na sha dang khrag zab yod/ de sgrub pa'i thabs bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zung shig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'bum bzlas la/ /'byung ba bzhi yi dkyil 'khor bri/ /de yi steng du khrag chen gyis/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ /btson dong tshul du bri bar bya/ /dar sngon de yi nang du bting / /dbus su mi yi sha dang khrag /dang po khyi ste gnyis pa phag /gsum par rna can zangs

gtsug phud/ /lnga par skad can drug par ra/ /bdun pa skye gnyis brgyad par glang / /g.yas kyi phyogs nas bskor ba'o/ /ma he rta dang lug dang spre'u/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas bskor ba'o/ /de ni dbul ba'i dam tshig go/ /khrag dang dug dang ske tshe yis/ /nam gyi phyed kyi dus dag tu/ /dur khrod ras la 'di ltar bri/ /zhal brgyad phyag stong yang na bcu/ /zhal bzhi dang po zhi ba ste/ /gnyis pa dmar po chu srin no/ /gsum pa khro nag yid dang khro/ /bzhi pa yi dgas mgo yin no/ /skra ni gyen brdzes zhal dang mtshungs/ /sprul pha bya rgod khra dang spyang / /de yi mgo can bri bar bya/ /dgug gzhug dbang ni bskrad par bya'o/ /'di ni bstan pa'i dam tshig go/ /bsnyen pa'i dam tshig gnyis dag gis/ /gsum rgyal dag las shes par bya/ /om̐ yak+ṣa ha sa ha sa da ra da ra hūm̐/ khra dang spyang ki khyi la sogs/ /rmi lam du 'am dngos su 'byung / /de nas mchod pa'i dam rdzas kun/ /bsgrub bya'i rdzas dang bsres byas la/ /gzugs brnyan byas la thod par gzhug /mar ngo gnod sbyin gzugs kyis mchod/ /om̐ yak+ṣa mā ra ya mā ra ya/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa rā kra mā ya phaṭa/ sar+b+ba shā trūṃ saṃ gha binā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba radha ra badz+ra pā ṇī rā dz+nyā pa ya ti mā ra ya tsit+ta la phaṭa/ des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /gzugs brnyan rdul la sbyin sreg bya/ /las skyes gzugs brnyan gong bur gzhug /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ oṃ yak+ṣa mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ nā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ tsit+ta la rbad rbad/ phyag gi rdo rjes bsnun par bya/ /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /nī lāṃ ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes ngo mtshar nas ched du brjod pa/ zung du 'brel bar gnas gyur pa/ /yam̐ las rlung ste pam̐ las pad/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las gnod sbyin sgrub pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems

dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba btab pa/ snying nas slob dpon smod pa la/ /klu gzhug pa ni ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje can gyis bshad du gsol/ /klu'i lag na nad bcu gcig yod de/ mdze dang / mdza' to dang / ka ta ma dang / ka she dang / 'bras dang / phol dang / shu ba dang / skem pa dang / g.yan pa dang / dmu chu dang / gag pa'o/ /klu'i gnas ni sa 'og gi rim pa bdun no/ /klu bran ni 'dzam bu'i gling na yang yod do/ /'khor ni rnam pa bzhi dag gis/ /gtsang ma'i gos dag gyon nas ni/ /dkar gsum dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /sngags rgyal nyi 'bum bzlas byas la/ /dkyil 'khor tsan+dan gur gum byug /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri bya ste/ /bdag nyid lag na rdo rje la/ /klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba bri/ /de la sogs pa bshad zin to/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni nub phyogs su/ /klu yi gzugs cig brtsam bya ste/ /rin chen lnga 'am gla rtsi 'am/ /mchod pa'i rdzas ni 'o ma sogs/ /dang po 'das pa'i mchod pa bya/ /spyan drang mchod dang bstod pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bya ba'o/ /klu yi snying gar hūm̐ bsgoms la/ /'od zer rnam pa gsum dag gis/ /klu chen gnas nas dgug par bya/ /gzugs brnyan de la bstim byas la/ /mchod pa dag gis mchod par bya/ /gzugs brnyan g.yo ba 'byung ba na/ /sdang pa'i lus la gzhug bya ste/ /dbang po brgyad nas gzhug bya ste/ /brgyad cha tha ma'i dus dag tu/ /'o ma gla rtsi kha ra yis/ /lam ni drang por drang byas la/ /gong bu dgug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de la klu chen gzhug par bya/ /sgrub pa po yis gu gul bsten/ /gzugs la phur bus gdab par bya/ /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /lha yi rnam pa nyid dag la/ /spogs pa dag gi cho ga bzhin/ /tad+ya thā/ hūm̐ phaṭa nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya hūm̐/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sar+b+ba shā trūṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ga rā ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti sha trūṃ tsit+ta mā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ nā ga gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/

sar+b+ba du ṭh+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra daṃ sh+ṭ+rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti nā ga kā ya bā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā rā ya phaṭa/ nā ga ut+sā da nā ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ sngags 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis khams gsum na gnas pa'i sems can rnams 'dar zhing brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das brgyal ba sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ā be sha gsungs pas thams cad kyang dbugs 'byung zhing brgyal ba sangs nas 'dar zhing thal mo sbyar nas ched du brjod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin nus pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzhal mi nus/ /rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las klu sgrub pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas gtam rgyud bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos lha gnas rnam pa brgyad du rgyud thams cad bsdus nas ri rab kyi byang phyogs su 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud gsungs so/ /de nas zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sngags gsungs pas lha dang lha ma yin gyi rna bar song ngo / /rig sngags 'chang de rnams ngo mtshar nas bstod pa byas so/ /de nas gling gi snying por 'khor gyi snying po gnod sbyin gyi cha 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje byon nas mar gyi snying po dang 'dra ba dam pa'i chos rgyud thams cad bsdus so/ /nyid kyi las gnyis kyi bdag nyid can rgyud sde stong phrag brgyad cu yang gsungs so/ /de nas 'jig rten du gnod sbyin rnams kyis mchod de/ sgron ma za ba rdo rjes mgo lus phral te nyams par byas so/ /de nas klu 'dul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sa 'og rim pa bdun du byon nas rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud gsungs so/ /rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud las gtam rgyud kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //rdo rjes 'og gi rgyud rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong bya'i gdong pa can gyis bsgyur ba'o// //

༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bhū mi tri tsa ra ṇi rā dza kalpa nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rjes gsum du rgyu ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang phyug po/ /shāka thub kyis ni rigs khro bo/ /phyis kyi rtog pa las rgyal byed/ /rtog pa'i bla ma 'di mchog bshad/ /lha dang sngags dang sbyor ba yis/ /rtog pas rtog pa 'joms pa'i lam/ /rtog pa med pa'i rig pa yis/ /khro bo'i dbang phyug zhi ba brnyes/ /dang po phyag 'tshal de 'og tu/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig gsum pas mdzes par byas/ /drug pa'i gsum pa blang byas la/ /'og tu dbyangs kyi gnyis pas brgyan/ /de la zla phyed dang thig le/ /lnga pa'i bzhi pa nyid dang ni/ /drug pa'i gnyis par nyid dang yang / /bzhi pa'i bzhi pa yang de bzhin/ /yang ni me yi sa bon dang / /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa yi/ /'og tu me yi sa bon no/ /lnga pa'i dang po nyid dang yang / /gsum pa'i sde pa lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan pa dang / /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' 'dod/ /lag na rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa la/ /gsum pa'i dang po mthar bzhag pa/ /'di rnams rig sngags dbang byed pa/ /gang gā klung bcu'i bye snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas khro bo byang chub sems/ /'byung por bcas pa 'gugs mdzad do/ /rig sngags rnams ni lha nyid de/ /stong dang snying rje 'dres pa yi/ /lha 'di snying ga'i sbyor ba ru/ /legs par bzhag pa bsam par bya/ /lugs su byung dang bzlog pa yi/ /sngags 'di bzlas dang bri bar bya/ /phaṭa hūm̐ ṇi pā dz+ra ba radha ra ba lāṃ nī om̐/ rig sngags 'bum phrag bzlas pa dang / /yi ge re la 'bum phrag dang / /de las lhag pa'i sbyor pa yis/ /sgrub pa po yi bsam pa ni/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dgug dang / /bskrad dang dbye rengs bsad pa dang / /las ni gang gang 'dod pa des/ /snying gar sbyor ba rim bzhin bsgrub/ /lus gtsang snying rjer ldan pa

yis/ /rang lus lha dang bla ma la/ /phyag sogs bya ba sngon 'gro bas/ /rig pa'i khro bo bsgom par bya/ /dang por stong nyid rnam bsams la/ /lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ /rang gi snying gar dbyangs yig ni/ /dang po las byung zla ba la/ /hūm̐ yig sngon po rnam par bsgom/ /rang gi 'dus 'dra'i 'od 'phros nas/ /sems can dri ma rnam bsal te/ /skur gyur snying po bsdu bar bya/ /hūm̐ yang rdo rje sngon por gyur/ /sngon bzhin spro dang bsdu byas la/ /sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /rab tu dregs pas khros pa'o/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng du ni/ /bde bar g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs/ /brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams tshul can/ /drag cing khros pa'i ro dang ldan/ /brang 'gro brgyad pos sku la brgyan/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /rang gis rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ /bsnun pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pa bsdigs pa'i mdzub mo can/ /na bza' sngon po'i sham thabs 'dzin/ /spyan mig dmar zhing mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra nyi ma'i 'od 'dra ba/ /steng du bcings dbus cod pan ldan/ /zhal nas hā hā'i gad rgyangs ldan/ /khro bo'i bdag po 'jigs par byed/ /log 'dren la sogs 'joms mdzad pa/ /de 'drar bdag nyid rab bsgoms la/ /de nas bdag nyid snyoms 'jug pa/ /de yi snying gar nyi ma la/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ge las/ /khros pas yang yang spros mdzad cing / /de dang lhan cig bsgom par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bcas pa yis/ /de bzhin du yang dbang blang zhing / /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad ting 'dzin gnas/ /gdug pa'i sems can 'dzin byed cing / /'od zer 'byung ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rims dang gdon dang dug sogs bza'/ /rdo rjes 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa dang po'o// //de nas spyan sogs skye mched la/ /hūm̐ byung khro bo bsgom par bya/ /sku sogs gsum la rdo rje gsum/ /bsgom pa 'di ni dbang byed pa'o/ /dang po zhi bas zhi bar bya/ /klu la sogs pa'i gzugs byas la/ /rang snying 'od kyis bkug la bstim/ /

mchod sbyin bya ba snying rjes sbyin/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas pad+ma dang / /pad chen dung skyong stobs kyi rgyu/ /dug rnams snying rje'i sbyor bas sbyang / /nag po dkar po sngon po dang / /rang gi gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /yang na zhi ba'i thab khung du/ /klu yi sdig pa zhi bar bya/ /shin tu gnag pa'i rigs de la/ /mngar gsum chu yis gso bar bya/ /gang zhig sdig can zhi mi 'dul/ /gnyis kyi sbyor bas rgyun gcod bya/ /khrag dang dug sogs rdzas dag la/ /rig pa bzlog pas bsgrubs nas ni/ /shin tu khros pa'i khro bo yis/ /dgug dang gzhug dang myos bsad dang / /cho gas gdug pa dbang byas la/ /bsreg pa la sogs las bya'o/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi'i dus kyi tshe/ /skya rengs shar dang dmar rengs cha/ /nyin mtshan zad pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /skra bkrol bcud 'dzag gcer bu ni/ /byol song gnas su khrag skyug go/ /lus dbus me 'bar bsgrub bya de/ /khro bo'i ba spu'i bu ga las/ /spros pa'i khro bo khros pa dang / /mngag gzhug rnams kyis drangs byas nas/ /rtog pas rtog pa bza' bar bya/ sngar ni rdo rjes 'og las/ /gdug pa 'dir ni bza' bar bya/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig dgos/ /ma bcos pa yi sems can la/ /snying rje'i yid can rdo rje sems/ /til sogs rdzas dang sngags sbyor gyis/ /sdig pa zhi byed sbyin sreg bya/ /rig pa'i blo can kun bzang gis/ /zho la bsreg bya rgyas pa'o/ /mi rtag gyur pa'i gdul bya la/ /'dod chags yid can bde chen gyis/ /bdag nyid dgos pa brtan bya'i phyir/ /ut+pal dmar sogs kyis bsgrub pa'o/ /'dir ni ma rungs sdig pa byed/ /gtsor ni sbyang phyir khro sems kyis/ /mngon spyod las ni rgyud kun las/ /bshad pa thams cad 'dir bya'o/ /rig sngags snying rje'i shugs kyis 'gro/ /las ngan rgyun gcod bcos ma yin/ /las ngan dag pa'i rang bzhin du/ /khros pas dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /sbyor ba rnams ni bcos mar 'gyur/ /byang chub bcos med 'bad

spangs pa'o/ /rdo rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal po/ /sngar ni sprul pa bcu drug pos/ /rtog pa bcu phrag dang bzhi yang / /gnyis kyis rig pa 'joms byed 'dir/ /sprul pa brgyad du bsdus pa dang / /bdag nyid gcig bu bsgom pa'ang gsungs/ /nam mkha'i khams su 'byung bzhi bsam/ /ri rab lhun po hrī yig las/ /pad+ma 'dab grangs lte ba la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'o/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhin bza' sngo/ /rdo rje dril bu mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan cing / /stag lpags smad dkris 'jigs sel ba/ /khro bo rnam rgyal bsgom par bya/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi sbyor ba yis/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs mtshams su/ /'jig rten gsum snang rdo rje dang / /'jig rten gsum 'dul rin chen dang / /'jig rten gsum 'ching pad+ma dang / /'jig rten gsum 'jig las nyid dag /g.yas rnams rang ming mtshan ma la/ /g.yon rnams gdug pa bsdigs pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil dang dbyug sngon dang / /mi g.yo ba dang rta mgrin khro/ /rdo rje dang ni dbyug pa dang / /ral gri pad+ma g.yas rnams so/ /g.yon pa gdug pa bsdigs pa'o/ /brgyad kyi dbus na khro bo bdag /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khrul pa sbyong / /dbyug pa nag sogs pho nya bzhi/ /sku mdog mtshan mas brgyan pa khros/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgor gnas pa/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo 'jigs sel bsgom/ /gtso bcas rig pa'i khro bo kun/ /rgyu ma'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /gos sngon can la stag lpags dkris/ /gdug pa sel ba'i lam du bsgom/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gtso/ /khro bo'i mtshan nyid sngags bcas bshad/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa dang

'tsham pa mig me ma dag gi phung po 'dra ba/ dbugs me lce ltar 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro can lag pa dang rkang pa klu nor rgyas kyi bus brgyan pa/ klu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 'bar bas rna cha byas pa/ sbrul 'bar ba rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa/ sbrul gdug pa 'bar ba za ba/ bzhin rgyas pa smin ma dang khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ gshin rje'i cha byad can lce glog ltar 'gyu ba/ gsus po che sbrul za ba/ lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs ska rags su bcings pa/ a la la zhes sgrogs par byed pa/ rgya mtsho'i zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa rkang pa'i pus mor phyin pa dbang po dang nyi ma phrag pa la khur ba klu thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gad rgyangs chen po rgod pas kun tu 'khrug par byed pa/ gshin rje'i gzugs can khams gsum pa 'jigs par byed pa/ klu thams cad rlag par byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tad+ya thā/ bho bho ban+nā gā dhi pa ta ye/ i dan+nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da yaṃ yaḥs mā ti kra ma tha mā ku lo t+sā da na/ bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ ta d+ya thā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha bi bud+dha/ ma hī prā p+ta ha ra ha ra nā gā nāṃ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ nā ga hṛ da yā ni/ bin+dha bin+bha nā ga marmā ṇi/ bi shi r+ya n+tu nā ga sha rī rā ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭi ya/ nā ga na ya nā ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tad+ya thā/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā got+sā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī laṃ ba sa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ra kra mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tan+tā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tān+ta rū pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā sa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kuṃ bhāṇ+ḍo t+sā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yak+ṣā pa smā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bigh+nā n+pi nā ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trūṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nīṃ

lāṃ ba radha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ de'i cho ga la gnod sbyin gyis zin pa la chu la sngags kyis btab ste gtor na btang bar 'gyur ro/ /klu zlog par 'dod na smyug shad kyi lcug ma'am bal po se'u'i lcug mas bya'o/ /yi dgas dang brjed byed rnams la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /rims nad med par bya ba dang / yig 'chus pa la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /nor 'dod na zhag gcig smyung par gnas te pog gis bdugs na rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba'i don thams cad ston par 'gyur la gser gyi dong tse bdun stong ster bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas btab pa dgrol bar 'dod na thal bas bya'o/ /sgo lcags dbye bar 'dod na yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba la ni mar rnying pa'am thal ba'am yungs kar gyis bya'o/ /nad kyis 'jigs pa thams cad la ni skud pa sngon po la bsrung ba'i mdud pa byas te mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /byis pa gdon gyis nyen pa la ni tshon sna lnga'i skud pa mgul du btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun bzlog par 'dod na sas bya'o/ /dug la ni rtswa ku shas byab par bya'o/ /bdag bsrung ba la ni yid kyis sam chus bya'o/ /gzhan bsrung ba la ni skud pa sngon pos bya'o/ /las de dag thams cad la sngags brjod pa ni lan gsum mam bdun nam bcu bzhi'am nyi shu rtsa gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rjes 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa gsum pa'o// //rtog pa 'di dag dbang byed pa/ /lag na rdo rje khros pa las/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bran g.yog rnams ni bskul bar bya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di ni bka' tsam nges bsgrag cing / /bai yig sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ /snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang bya zhing / /gu gul dud pas brod byas la/ /gser sna chen po seng ge la zhon pa dang / rmugs 'dzin dang / gang ba bzang dang / nor bu bzang dang / ku be ra dang / yang dag shes dang / 'brog

gnas dang / lngas rtsen dang / pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li rnams la mkho ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'di rnams rta la bcibs pa la/ /'od dang ldan zhing me long can/ /ras dkar gtsang mas gsal byas la/ /gsal snang kun ni bri bar bya/ /yang na kun kyang sbrul nag bcibs/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /bskul ba dag par dbang byas na/ /mngon spyod las kun byed par 'gyur/ /drag po dgu dang nyi shu brgyad/ /sa gsum khyab pa spros nas ni/ /sngags grub stobs kyis bdag bran byed/ /dus tshod dus la mchod par byed/ /de nas dbul bas 'jigs pa la/ /rmugs 'dzin bsgrub pa yid 'ong bshad/ /kun kyang gter rnams mnan pa la/ /rin chen 'bar bas khyim 'gengs pa/ /skyor gang rdo rje chus 'grub 'gyur/ /pad+ma zla dang gter chen la/ /dzom̐ las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dgu/ /bkug la rang rang gsang sngags kyis/ /chu dang bcas pa'i mchod sbyin dbul/ /'di ni sngags kyi rkang pa rnams so/ /om̐ bai shra pa ṇā ya swā hā/ om̐ dzaṃ bha lā ya swā hā/ om̐ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ om̐ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ om̐ ku be rā ya swā hā/ om̐ saṃ pra dz+nya nā ya swā hā/ om̐ gu h+ya s+thā nā ya swā hā/ om̐ pāñtsi kā ya swā hā/ om̐ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ne swā hā/ de nas yang dag spyod pa'i mchog /lha yi brtul zhugs dag pa bshad/ /dus rnams kun du dar ras gtsang ma'i gos sngon byin gyis brlab bya zhing / /bram ze'i rigs ltar dri can zas dang 'gro mgyogs sha las ring du 'dug /smyung bar gnas shing chus bkrus dkar gsum dag dang gtsang ba'i zas za zhing / /ngag gi rlung bsdams dad dang snying rjes yid brlan rtag tu brtson par 'jug /bsam gtan khang pa mdog ni sngo bsgyur ba lci dri zhim chu yis byugs/ /dkar dang sngo ba'i me tog bkram la sku gdung bla ma mdun bzhag la/ /cho rigs btsun pa'i sgrub pos gos dkar bgos la ku sha'i stan la 'dug /snying rjes khros pa'i rig sngags dam pa dag cing mdzes par bzlas par bya/ /ru drāk+ṣa yi bgrang phreng brgya phyed byin gyis brlabs la lag g.yas gzung / /

phreng ba'i ril bu re dang lha re sngags re bcas nas snying gar gzung / /rnal 'byor 'di rnams rnam par dpyad cing 'gro la 'jungs pa'i sems ldan pas/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du rtog pa bshad pa byas pa yin/ /rdo rje sa 'og tu rgyu ba las rtog pa bzhi pa'o// //dbyar kha skyes pa'i rtswa dang nags tshal las byung me mched ltar/ /rlung gis grogs byas bsregs nas thal ba'i lhag ma'ang ma lus bzhin/ /bskal pa dpag med skyes pa'i rtog pa'i dri ma'i rma rnams la/ /bsrung ba dad dang brtson 'grus sngags bzlas sems dag me yis bsreg /nyi ma'i snying po 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus su rigs bzung ste/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med dbang po skyon med tshul khrims can/ /skye ba snga ma'i lam shugs dag dang bla ma'i lung thob pa/ /dad dang snying rje'i sems can gtong ba'i blo dang ldan pa des/ /rig pa'i khro bo bsgom dang de rjes de ni bzlas 'bad na/ /bstod dang mchod mnyes bran g.yog lha min gsang ba brnyas med cing / /chu yi mchod sbyin 'khor lo dag dang gtor ma la brtson zhing / /sbyin sreg rnams kyis lha dang bran g.yog mnyes byas na/ /ring por mi thogs sgrub pa po des rtags dang phyag rgya 'byin par 'gyur/ /'dir ni mang du smra mi dgos/ /sngar ni rdo rjes 'og tu/ /bshad pa'i mtshan ma ster bar 'gyur/ /zangs lcags bla ma'i gnang bya'o/ /lus sogs rig pa'i dbang bskur nas/ /me dang rlung sogs 'byung ba dang / /nad dang gdon dang byad rnams dang / /bdud kyis glags ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /me lce phreng ba'i rtog pa las/ /bshad pa'i 'chi ba'i sbyor byung na/ /ser sna 'di ni pha rol 'phang / /smon lam lam sna la brten nas/ /'di 'og byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'gro ba smin pa'i bla mar 'gyur/ /yang na srid pa bar ma dor/ /sngags kyis rnam shes gzi bskyed nas/ /'gro phan rig 'dzin gyur nas/ /de yi 'og tu sems dpa'o/ /tha ma'ang lam brten nas ni/ /rang 'dod pa yi lus rnyed nas/ /snga ma lam sel de 'og tu/ /dngos grub la ni

rnam par gnas/ /lha dang sngags sogs rtogs pa des/ /rtog pa dman pa mnan pa yin/ /nam mkha' lta bur rtog med la/ /'jig rten dor ni rtog pas sprul/ /gdul bya sdang sogs sems 'khrugs la/ /nga ni snying rjes sdang bar mdzad/ /khro sogs bsal du med gyur na/ /khro bor da ni ci phyir 'gyur/ /dang po rnal 'byor 'tshe ba bcom/ /de phyir rig sngags sbyor ba rnams/ /rgyud kun du ni gsungs pa yin/ /'tshe ba bcom nas dag pa ni/ /sems dag pa ni bde ba yin/ /gdug pa'i sbyor ba phrogs pas na/ /bde bar byang chub lam brten la/ /rdo rje sku nyid 'gyur med la/ /bdag gis rig pa'i ye shes de/ /lus can de yi 'bras bu'o/ /ji ltar shel ni dzam bu ka'i/ /me tog gis ni gzhan du snang / /de bzhin rtog med rig pa yang / /khro bo'i dbang phyug 'dir snang nas/ /ji ltar 'dul 'gyur sprul pa yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par khro bor snang / /snying rje med na 'bras bu nyams/ /'gro la phan btags gnod bsal na/ /rang sems dag pas 'bras bu 'grub/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgrib pa rnams/ /byang chub sems kyis ring du spang / /'di ni 'khor ba 'jig par nges/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i sgrib pa rnams/ /blo mnyam dus na gnyen po dang / /mi mthun nam mkha' ltar yangs pa/ /lhun gyis grub 'bras phyi ma yin/ /ji srid rtog pa'i dri ma yod/ /de srid 'bad de rig pa bsgom/ /sems sbyong snga ma rig pa yis/ /rgyud nyid du ni 'dod pa yin/ /gang la sems ni dri med pa/ /rtog pa'i dri mas nag por byas/ /de la spang ba'i blo med pa'o/ /rtog pa'i blo can 'khor ba yin/ /de phyir shākya'i rigs can rnams/ /sa 'og tu rgyu ba'i klu'i rtog pa la sogs pa tshar gcad pa'i phyir sbyor ba rnams la gus par bya'o/ /rdo rjes gsum du rgyu ba las rtog pa lnga pa rdzogs so// //dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' khrims su/ dpal dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra badz+ra dang / ra byid lo ts+tsha bas bsgyur ba'o// //

rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra pā ṇi nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra tri lo ka bi na ya nā ma ta n+t+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri rab kyi byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang na bzhugs te/ brjod kyis mi lang ba'i lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la sogs pa la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams ma 'jigs shig /ma skrag shig /ma dngang zhig ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thugs ka'i dpal gyi be'u la 'od zer kha dog gsum las grub pa 'od zer kha dog gsum pa'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma 'jig rten gsum du bkye ste/ thams cad bkug nas slar yang 'od kyis snang bar byas nas/ om̐badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pa tsa du sh+ṭān+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ tir+ya bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ pre ta bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ na ra bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ na ra ga ṇa bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ de ba bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ ces gsungs pas/ 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi lus gas nas sems shel sgong lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /sems yi ge gsum lta bur gnas te/ om̐ ni zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /āḥni zhal gcig phyag gnyis te/ /hūm̐ ni rgyan dang bral gyur pa/ /rigs ni gsum du gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rigs gsum du gyur pas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /zhe sdang chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /phyag na rdo rje rnyed dka' ba/ /bdag cag gis ni thob par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa thugs bskul ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da yaṃ da/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ tad+ya thā/

bho bho bān+nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i daṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da yaṃ/ yaḥs mā ti kra ma tha ut+sā da naṃ bha pi ṣ+ya ti/ bstod pa 'dis bstod pas 'gyur ba bcu gnyis dang / ltas bcwa brgyad byung bas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas 'byung ba'i lha dang mi la sogs pa thams cad skrag nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyis rang rang gi gdul bya rnams ma 'jigs shig /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje bzhugs pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa la bstod pa'i ltas yin gyis zhes gsungs so/ /rang rang gi 'khor dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang rang gi 'jig rten mkhyen pa la gsol pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ byang chub sems dpa' de lta bar 'tshal na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas rang rang gi 'khor rnams rang rang gi ston pa'i 'od la 'jus nas ri rab kyi steng na lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi nang du rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa byon no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod de bstod pa byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bstod pa yi/ /ngo mtshar ltas kyis 'dir mchis pas/ /'jig rten du 'byung dka' ba yis/ /tshar gcad rjes bzung bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang bskur ba mdzad do/ /a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes gsungs pas snod dang ldan par byas so/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod de lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang du phyag byas nas gsol ba btab pa/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bsrung ba rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /phyag na rdo rje bsrung ba'i rgyud/ /zhe sdang gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhe sdang kun

gyi rgya mtsho gtso/ /'bar ba drag po spyan yangs pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /dbus su phyag na rdo rje bri/ /de mtha' mtshan ma nyi shu bzhi/ /rang dbus sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ dang / /sde tshan dang po bcwa brgyad dgos/ /dbus mtshan lte bar ming bris la/ /de rnams phyag na rdo rje'i dbus/ /dbus ma'i phyag na rdo rje la/ /bstod pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /klu 'dul sngags kyis bskor bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas klu 'dul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas gang gā klung gis gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di bka' stsal to/ /tad+ya thā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha bi bud+dha/ ma hi prā p+ta/ ha ra ha ra nā gā nāṃ/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā gā nāṃ/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da nā ga hṛ da yā ni/ bhin+da bhin+da nā ga marmā ṇi/ bi shi r+yan+tu nā ga sha rī raṃ ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sngags des klu rnams skrag ste/ rang rang gi gnas su 'bros par chas pa las nā ga ya nā ni zhes gsungs pas lus mi g.yo bar gyur to/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi ste/ rang rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /phyi yi phyag na rdo rje la/ /lha srin sngags kyis bskor bar bya/ /gnyis la rigs kyi nag pos brgyan/ /rgyan dang cha lugs tshang ba la/ /dbus nas rim pa ci bzhin du/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ mtha' pā ṇi'i sngags/ /phreng ba bsnams pa bri bar bya/ /oṃ gyis rdo rje lte bar mtshan/ /hūm̐ gis shes rab lce la mtshan/ /phyi yi lcags ri dag la ni/ /thabs dang shes rab dag kyang bri/ /bsgrub bya rdo rje lte bar bca'/ /gur kum gyis ni bri bar bya/ /yar ngo'i tshes brgyad nas bzung ste/ /bris nas de nub nas bzung ba/ /bcu bzhi bar du bsnyen par bya/ /bcwa lnga'i nub mo bsgrub pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor cha lugs ldan pa la/ /lha snam steng du pus btsugs la/ /cho ga bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /'khor lo dag la bsang byas la/ /'khor lo stong pa nyid du

bsgom/ /stong pa nyid las hūm̐ byung ste/ /de zhu ba las rdo rje ni/ /badz+ra pā ṇis lte bar mtshan/ /de las 'phro dang 'dus pa las/ /phyag na rdo rje'i skur bskyed la/ /de snying zla ba rdo rjes mtshan/ /rdo rje lte bar hūm̐ mtshan las/ /'od zer spros te gos sngon bsdu/ /de la mchod pa sna tshogs mchod/ /bstod dang bdun po byas nas kyang / /'od zer dag gis bkug byas la/ /rang snying rdo rje hūm̐ la thim/ /de la mchod bstod sna tshogs bya/ /rdo rje dag las ye shes kyi/ /me byung rdo rje zhu gyur nas/ /'khor lo'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ /sku ni sku yi rnam pa ste/ /mtshan ma mtshan ma'i rnam par ro/ /sa de bsdus pa ki rti dang / /bsregs pa'i nang du 'khor lo gzhug /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes bstod pa/ sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /ston pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /gdul dka' thams cad 'dul ba yi/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ngo mtshar che/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud las sa 'og 'dul ba ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyag na rdo rje rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas phyag 'tshal te gsol ba btab pa/ /de nas sngags snying kun 'dus pa/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ston pa dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rig sngags gcod byed bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rig sngags gcod/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /dang po bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ /mchod rten sngon po brtsigs pa dang / /ras ris la sogs bri bya ste/ /lce yi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /yi ge brgya pas bshags par bya/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /stong pa nyid las 'di gsum mtha'/ /yongs su gyur pas rdo rje ste/ /de la badz+ra pā ṇis mtshan/ /lte dbus sngags la lha spro bsdu/ /byas pas phyag na rdo rjer gyur/ /lha yi sku mdog rgyan la sogs/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las shes par bya/ /bdag nyid thugs ka'i dpal be'u las/ /

'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan bsdu/ /'od zer gnyis pa'i rtse mo las/ /mchod pa rnam pa bcu spros te/ /bcom ldan tshogs la mchod pa bya/ /de nas yang dag bstod byas la/ /'od zer gsum pas snying gar gzhug /snying ga'i mtshan ma zla dkyil thim/ /badz+ra nyi shu gcig dbus gnas/ /de la sngags rgyal bskor bar bya/ /sngags ni rnam pa bzhi ru bshad/ /ming dang don dang spel ba dang / /bzlas pa dag dang rnam pa bzhi/ /bzlas pa rnam pa bcu drug tu/ /rgyud 'di las ni rab tu grags/ /rdo rje yi ni bzlas pa dang / /rin chen pad+ma'i bzlas pa dang / /las kyi bzlas pa bzhi po dag /las bzhi po ni rang bzhin can/ /rang bzhin rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /drag po'i las dang zo chun rgyud/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo'i bzlas pa dang / /mda' dang sbrul gyi bzlas pa dang / /'gog pa yi ni bzlas pa dang / /sku bsrungs bka' nyan bzlas pa'o/ /khyab 'jug mdung dang tshangs pa'i gzhu/ /mar me lta bu'i bzlas pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i mtshan ma'i rang bzhin te/ /rtag tu lha rnams bum pa yis/ /dbang bskur byed pa byung ba'am/ /yang na lo brgyad lon pa 'byung / /yang na me tog sngon po ste/ /ma byung na yang dus bsnyen bya/ /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi ru bshad/ /zhi rgyas bsdus dang drag po ste/ /'dir ni drag po'i gtso bo'o/ /dkyil 'khor nyams su blang ba'o/ /bla ma lnga ru shes par bya/ /bdag nyid rgyan dang ldan pa la/ /shar gyi phyogs su blta bar bya/ /cho ga gsum gyis dbyung ba'o/ /dpal be'u zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la/ /bcom ldan cho ga bzhin du bskyed/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /dpal be'u zhu bas ye shes so/ /mtha' ma skar ma lta bu yi/ /rang bzhin dpal be'u hūm̐ dang ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dkyil las/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /de yi dbus su bsgrub bya gzhag /hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i phur bu ni/ /de yi lce las brten par bya/ /gu gul nag po'i

spos kyis ni/ /de yi sna nas bdug par bya/ /sngags rgyal nā ga bor nas ni/ /mā ra dzi ha gzhug par bya/ /de ni rigs ngan thod par gzhug /mchod rten 'og tu mnan par bya/ /de steng dug gsum mgo bo ni/ /om̐ āḥhūm̐/ dar dkar gcig gis phur byas la/ /rim pa dang por gzhug par bya/ /de steng rim pa lnga pa la/ /sha chen la sogs lnga po dag /hūm̐ tram̐ hriḥ.ā a/ ra rog kha ru gzhug par bya/ /rim pa bzhi pa dag la ni/ /'khor lo gzhug par bya ba de/ /yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me/ /de steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri/ /de steng nyi ma zla ba ste/ /'khor lo dbus kyi lte ba la/ /dgra bo'i mgo bo thur bstan bri/ /de yi snying gar ming bri'o/ /'khor lo yi ni rtsibs brgyad te/ /rtsibs la sngags kyis bskor bar bya/ /ming las bsgrub bya hūm̐ las ston/ /'og gi las ni gnyis kyang bri/ /khra dang spyang ki la sogs pa'i/ /thod par gzugs brnyan bcug nas ni/ /yungs kar dag gis brab byas la/ /rang gi 'og tu gnan par bya/ /gu gul nag po'i spos dag gis/ /de yi sna nas bdug par bya/ /seng ldeng phur bu sor bzhi pa/ /gdab pa'i sngags kyis lce la gdab/ /rdo rje rgya gram dag gis ni/ /de yi bu ga pa dgab par bya/ /nya dang 'byung po'i nyi ma la/ /phur bu bskul zhing yungs kar brdeg /de nas rig sngags 'chang de rnams kyis ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brdzod do/ /e ma'o ston pa khyad par 'phags/ /e ma'o thabs kyang khyad par 'phags/ /e ma'o 'khor yang khyad par 'phags/ khyad par 'phags pa ngo mtshar che/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud las sa bla 'dul ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas byon pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa/ bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /sa steng 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje chen pos bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /

gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po spong ba ni/ /bsdu ba'i dngos por bsdu bar bya/ /de yang dbang du ma gyur na/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas skur ni bsams nas su/ /de yis gsad bsgom nyes pa bsgrag /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje 'dzin/ /snying ga nas ni spros byas la/ /de yis bsrung dang 'jig rten lha/ /zhags pa dag gis drangs nas ni/ /om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ be sha dzaḥ/ /mtshon cha dag gis bcad la sogs/ /om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭām̐ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ klu yi bzlas pa 'bum byas te/ /nya dang 'byung po'i nyi ma la/ /bdag nyid rgyan dang ldan byas la/ /rdzas dang sngags kyis bsrung bar bya/ /bzhi mdo lha khang dus nam phyed/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bzlas byas te/ /de nas 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /steng 'khor 'og 'khor dug shing gis/ /dga' dang legs pa'i sems kyis bri/ /ras ma nyams la gur gum mchog /dbus su phyag na rdo rje la/ /dpral ba snying ga lkog ma ru/ /yi ge gsum bkod sku gsum ste/ /rgyan dang cha lugs tshang bar bri/ /'khor yug thams cad duṣ+ṭaṃ bri/ /zhabs dang spyi bo g.yas dang g.yon/ /zla ba nyi ma dbus su ni/ /rgyal po bzhi yi mtshan ma bri/ /mtshams bzhir rdo rje'i gdan la hūm̐/ /'khor yug la ni shes rab thabs/ /hūm̐ las dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes spyan drang mchod de zhu/ /'og 'khor sbal nag yan lag lnga/ /snying dang drug tu ming rus gzhug /phyogs bzhir rtsibs la mtshams bzhir thod/ /rtsibs dang thod par ming rus te/ /khor yug gnyis la bstod pas bskor/ /sbal khar hri las 'od byung bas/ /sa bdag klu chen bkug ste mchod/ /mchod pa'i rdzas ni 'o ma sogs/ /de nas bsgral bya dgug bya ste/ /sku gsung thugs la legs gnas pa/ /ming dang rus la bstim ste bzhag /thod pa las srin hūm̐ las bskyed/ /de la sbyor ba

legs par bya/ /klu la dam bdar mchod pa bya/ /phur pas phyogs mtshams gcad par bya/ /'og mas phyogs su drangs na 'grub/ /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa rnams/ /ngo mtshar nas ched du brjod pa/ /rmad byung chen po chos rnams la/ /rnam par mi rtog ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa la/ /kun rdzob tu yang bshad pa mtshar/ /de nas thog mar gyur pa'i 'khor rnams 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas byon pa'i ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mtho 'tshams nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gnod byed thams cad zlog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da ya gsungs pas gzhan nas byon pa'i ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs bskul nas/ tabyathā/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ nā got+sā da nā ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta pa la pa rākra mā ya phaṭa/ kṛ tān+tā ya phaṭa/ kṛ tān+ta rū pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇā ya phaṭa/ trā sa nā ya phaṭa/ kuṃ bhaṇ+ṭa ut+sā da nā ya phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pa smā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dā ra dā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bigh+nān bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba sha trūṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ gsungs pa tsam gyis dang po'i 'khor rnams skrag par gyur te ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o ston pa byin rlabs che/ /e ma sngags kyi nus pa che/ /e ma che ba'i nyon mongs che/ /'khor rnams mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud las sa steng 'dul ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gsum dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas byon pa'i 'jig rten gsum po rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te rang rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la rgyud 'di 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'di chongs shig /lhogs shig

ces gsungs so/ /yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri sa ma ya byū ha rā dzā nā ma tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na rnam par gnas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbus dang mtha' med yon tan ri bo dpag med dang / /mchod rten mtha' med mchod pa chen po'i mchog tu 'khrungs/ /mchod chen 'phags pa'i 'phags pa chen po'i bdag /dus gsum 'khrungs pa'i bder gshegs tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rdo rje chen po'i nye 'khor/ rdo rje 'chang chen po nye bar 'du ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lhag par dgyes pas rnam par rol pa/ dbus dang mtha' med pa'i rdo rje chen po'i rtse mo mthon po rin po che'i rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rgyu las gyur pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po'i mchog na byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul rdzu 'phrul chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rgya chen por mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa snying po thogs pa med pa don yod par grub pa gsungs te/ na ma s+t+re ya dh+wi kā nāṃ/ ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba trā pra ti ha tā bā p+ti/ dharma tā ba li nāṃ/ am̐ a/ sa ma sa ma sa man+ta to/ /a nan+tā bā p+ti/ shā sa ni ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇi/ bi ga ta rā ga bud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na ma hā ba ra ṇa

la k+ṣa ṇe dz+wa la dz+wa la na/ sā ga re swā hā/ de la rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs dang shes rab dang ldan pa sngags kyi sgor byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa 'dis las gang zhig byed par 'gyur ba de ni bskal pa brgyar yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan par mi spyod kyi/ gzhan du mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no/ /'dis skyes bu dam pa de ni sgo mtha' yas pas sems can thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la lhag par dmigs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo la sogs pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo sna tshogs pa'i rjes su zhugs pa/ sems can 'dul ba'i sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs pas gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rtse ba/ las thams cad rjes su dran pa'i cho ga yang dag par sbyor ba'i gzungs thob par 'gyur zhing sems can gyi khams dang mos pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pa mngon par sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs dang stobs sna tshogs mngon par sgrub par byed pa'i sgo sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mos pas snying po 'di bzlas na gzugs sna tshogs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor bsdus na sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yang sgra 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /gser dang nor bu dang mu tig la sogs pa'i char yang mngon par 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad du yi dgas rnams la bza' ba dang bca' ba dang btung ba yang mngon par rab tu 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba rnams kyi grang ba la dro ba yang yang dag par skyed par byed do/ /dud 'gro rnams kyi gcig la gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal yang rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /sems can mos pa'i sgo sna tshogs pa'i yul can gyi sems can gyi khams rnam par sbyong bar byed do/ /byin gyis rlob par byed/

yongs su 'gengs par byed/ yongs su smin par byed/ rnam par 'dul bar byed/ nges par sbyong bar byed/ kun du sbyor bar byed/ rnam par 'phel bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ so sor 'god par byed/ rnam par grol bar byed/ byang chub kyi theg pa la lhag par 'dzeg par byed/ myur du lhag par 'dzeg pa'i sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag kyang ston par byed/ mdor na mthar gyis byang chub la gzhol zhing so sor 'god par byed/ dge ba sgrub pa la gnas pa skyed par byed/ sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa zad par byed/ rnam par 'joms par byed/ rnam par sel bar byed/ 'dren par byed/ 'joms par byed/ mdor na rang gi smon lam gyi stobs dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyis sems can gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa yang byed par 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams kyi don yongs su mi nyams par bya ba'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ sngags 'dzin pas dang por re zhig byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byis pa so so'i skye bo'i sa las 'das pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi brlabs rnyed pa 'di nyid la bdag nyid dad par bya'o/ /sgrub pa po'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos snga dro dang po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag nyid dbul bar bya ste/ bdag ming che ge mo zhes bgyi ba chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de rnams kyis kyang bdag la rnam pa thams cad dang dus thams cad du byin gyis brlab pa dang yongs su bzung bar gyur cig /bdag la grub pa dang mchog stsol cig /de nas sdig pa so sor bshags par bya ste/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug las skyes pa'i sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis thugs bskyed

pa gang gis bshags pa mdzad pa'i sems bskyed pa des bshags par bya ste/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa ltar des kyang ji tsam du bshags par nus pa de tsam du bshags par bya'o/ /de nas bsod nams la rjes su yi rang bar bya ste/ gang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs sems can gyi khams rnam par sbyor bar byed pa/ sems can gyi khams yongs su srung bar byed pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pas rjes su yi rang bar bya ste/ ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas mkhyen pa ltar/ des kyang ji ltar rjes su yi rang bar nus pa de ltar rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa'i bya ba bya ste/ sems can gyi khams na gang nga yar med cing yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga de thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchod pa'i phrin las kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs dang bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchog tu rgya che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog rgya chen po'i gong ma las bla mar mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab tu 'bab pa bsam pa'am brjod pa/ mchod pa chen por mngon par sgrub par byed pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di lan brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ sarba thā/ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa haṃ maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ji ltar mngon par bsngos pa ltar de bzhin du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mkhyen to/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la yon tan du bsngags

pa dang / grags pa sna tshogs kyi glu'i sprin rgya mtsho rab 'byam tshig tu brjod pa'am bsams la/ 'di lta bu'i bstod pa dpe med pa nges par sgrub par byed pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di lan brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bod+dhi sa twā nāṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku su mi ta a bhi dz+nyā rā shi ni na mo stu te swā hā/ de nas de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yon tan bsngags pa brjod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bur yang dad par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus kyi sprul pa'i sprin sems can thams cad la dmigs pa las byung ba sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / bde ba thams cad myur du stsol cig pa'am/ yang na sems can thams cad kyi zag pa med pa'i dge ba 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yang dag par 'byung ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi grub pa'i mchog de dag gis thob par gyur cig ces de lta bu la sogs pa sems can thams cad la phan pa'i bsam pa yid la byed pa'am ngag tu brjod de/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i sprin mngon par bsgrub pa'i rgyu dang sems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed pa dang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po 'di lan brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ na mo stu te ma hā brdza sarba sa twā hi taṃ ka ra/ tiṣ+tha sarba tra/ sar+b+be ṣāṃ dhar+m+mā ṇāṃ a dhiṣ+thā ya swā hā/ rig pa'i rgyal po 'di brjod pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyis de dag gi sprul pa'i sprin rgya chen po mos pas mngon par bsgrubs nas/ mdor na sems can gyi khams su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mdzad pa yang byed par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa can gyis de dag la yang dag par dad par bya'o/ /de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' kho nas mkhyen to/ /de nas de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang / rjes su yi rang ba la

sogs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bdag sdug bsngal bar gyur pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad du byin gyis brlab pa dang bdag la grub pa'i mchog stsol cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang / dmigs pa dang / bzlas pa dang / nan tan du bgyis pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi dngos grub la sogs pa grub pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang / dmigs pa dag la goms pa'i sems kyis bla na med pa'i snying po 'di ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa de srid bzlas pa bzla bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang bla na med pa'i seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / sems can gyi don bla na med pa byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun du bzang po'i sku yongs su sgrub par 'dod pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas nas ldang bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa rig pa rgya chen po'i tshul gyi mdo sde rnams mngon par mchod cing klog pa'am tha na phyag byas nas zas bza' bar bya ste/ dang po zas la sngags 'dis lan brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas nas kham gyi dang po lha nyid la dbul zhing de'i 'og tu zas bza' bar bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ na maḥsarba budha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ oṃ ba liṃ dā te/ te dzo mā lī ni swā hā/ kha zas kyis dub pa spangs nas kyang snga dro'i bya ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad phyi dro'i yang bya ba yin no/ /nyal na yang yan lag thams cad kyis dang por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas nas bstod de mal stan la 'dug cing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab pa dang bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog bdag la stsol cig /rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba yang gdab par bya'o/ /mtshan gyi

dang po dang tha ma la mi nyal ba'i sbyor bas dam pa'i chos 'don pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /sgrub pa po'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des de bzhin du nyi ma re re zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dang por phyag bya ba dang nyin re zhing bdag dbul ba dang de bzhin du sdig pa so sor bshags pa dang 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la rjes su yi rang ba dang sems can thams cad la rang gi bsod nams bstab pa dang dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam la phyag byas nas bcang ba dang klog pa'am sgom pa dang / tha na mchod pa byas nas dad pas snying po 'di bzla bar bya ba yin te/ ri'am lha khang ngam khyim mam brang khang la sogs pa'i gnas su/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la lhag par dmigs shing bzlas pas sems can thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang ldan pa'i sems kyis stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sa don du gnyer zhing mngon par 'dod pas 'bum bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' mthong bar 'gyur zhing des ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs la sogs pa'am/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la zhugs pa'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i thabs dang shes rab la mkhas pa de dag gi bzlas pa'i cho ga yin no/ /gal te rig pa 'dzin par gyur cig ces yid la byed la bzlas pa 'bum yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ bcwa lnga'am bcu gsum mam bcu bzhi'i nyin mtshan la gso sbyong byas la/ ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa byas nas me tog gi gcal bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ mchod rten nam lugs sku 'am dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam mdun du bzhag la/ ku sha'i khres po'am gcal du bkram pa la 'dug pa'am lo ma la nye bar 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchog slong bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag bya ba dang / dmigs pa dang bzlas pas lcags kyi 'khor lo lag pa la thogs

la ji srid du 'bar bar ma gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa byas na 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / sa chen po 'gul bar 'gyur te/ rig pa 'dzin pa de dag thams cad 'dus shing de dag gis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i rigs su bsod nams ji lta ba dang rang gi skal ba ji lta ba'i gnas rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid du phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub pa'i sa thob par 'gyur te de la lus nyams par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /thabs mkhas pa nyid kyis 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyad kyang gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo'i rim pa ji lta ba de bzhin du rdo rje dang mdung dang ral gri dang rtse gcig pa dang gtun shing dang dbyug pa dang sta re dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang gri gug dang chu gri dang lcags kyu la yang bsgrub par bya'o/ /thabs mkhas pa dang ldan zhing sems can yongs su bsrung ba'i blo can lus dang srog la ltos pa med pa/ thams cad du rjes su 'gro ba'i yid la byed pas lcags dang / gser dngul dang lcags gsum dang tsan+dan dang rdo dang tha na shing dngas las byas pa'am/ ta la'i lo ma'i rang bzhin las byas pa la sngar smos pa'i tshogs gcig pu dben par 'dug ste 'bum bzlas pas bsgrubs na gong ma bzhin rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ldong ros sam/ mig sman nam ba bla 'am gi wang la sogs pa lo ma'i bar ram/ gos kyi bar ram lcags kyi snod kha sbyar du bcug la bsgrub par bya ba'am/ gos sam rgyal mtshan nam nor bu'am mu tig gi phreng ba la sogs pa rgyan rnams sam/ pad+ma 'am ut+pal la sogs pa me tog gi khyad par ram/ ska rags sam lhung bzed dam chos gos sam 'khar gsil la sogs pa'i yo byad lag par chud pa'am lo ma'am gos sam zhags pa la bsgrubs na 'bar bar 'gyur zhing rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ci snyed kyi grogs 'dod pa de snyed kyi grogs dang lhan cig 'phur zhing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /thogs pa med pa don yod par grub pa'i snying po 'di yang bsod nams dang ldan pa'am/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pas

kyang rung 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims dang ldan pa yang rung / tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /thabs dang ldan pa'am thabs dang mi ldan pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /mkhas kyang rung mi mkhas kyang rung nges par don yod par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du dad pa med pa dang byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa rnams kyis ma yin no/ /bris sku med kyang rung mchod kyang rung / mchod pa med kyang rung / khrus la sogs pa med kyang rung / phyi'i spyod pa gtsang sbra la sogs pa med kyang rung / nya sha dang sha dag la sogs pa yongs su ma spangs kyang rung 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs pa bsgoms pa'i sems kyis 'grub bo/ /gal te bris sku la sgrub par 'dod pas thad ka la bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i ri bo la rin po che'i pad+ma'i steng na bzhugs pa bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon logs su 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pus mo btsugs nas pad+ma la bzhugs pa rdo rje dang bcas par thal mo sbyar ba ut+pa la'i lo ma'i mdog gam pri yang ku lta bur sngo bsangs sam gser gyi mdog can bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes bya ba rdo rje 'dzin gser gyi mdog can ral pa dang cod pan can gos ser po gyon pa lag pa g.yon gyis lcags kyu yongs su 'dzin pa bri bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu ming ngam mtha' med ces bya ba'i 'khor 'bar ba'i snying po can khros shing 'khrugs par gyur pa nor bu'i zur phud kyis brgyan pa a sho ka dmar po'i mdog can lag pa na gri gug dang zhags pa thogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'og tu gzhon nu ma g.yon na zur phud gcig pa nag po sngo bsangs rol par gyur pas 'khor la dga' ba dang bcas pas blta ba/ gos sngon po gyon pa lag na me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa mtha' med ma zhes bya ba pho nya mo bri bar bya'o/ /'dir yang bris sku la gzhan du yang las de dag nyid dang sgrub pa de dag nyid bya ba'am rtog pa thams cad kyi cho ga'i sbyor ba'am yid la 'dod pa'i cho ga sbyar bar bya'o/

dur khrod du 'bum bzlas na rdo rje 'dzin 'ongs nas lag pa nas bzung ste lcang lo can du 'dren par byed do/ /des rdo rje'i rigs kyi gzhon nur gyur pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa dngos po ral gri la sogs pa la bsnyen pa byas pa des rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtshor zhugs nas 'bum bzlas na klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i gnas su phyin par 'gyur zhing klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu'am rdo rje'am ral gri'am 'khor lo'am rin po che la sogs pa de rnams kyi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por 'gro ba dang 'ong nus par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rigs thams cad blo mthun par 'gyur ro/ /char chen po rnam pa sna tshogs pa mngon par 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i mtshe'u gang du 'bum bzlas na klu'i gnas der rab tu 'jug par 'gyur zhing / der gang 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gang gār zhugs shing 'bum bzlas la 'bum yongs su rdzogs nas de nyid du mchod rten brtsigs la sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma dang yungs kar dang bcas pas sbyin sreg byas na/ klu thams cad skrag pas lhags par 'gyur zhing gang smras pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod du yungs kar gyis sbyin sreg byas na gnod sbyin gong ma bzhin byed par 'gyur ro/ /ri'i lha la 'bru mar dang tsan+dan gyi sbyin sreg gis sam nags kyi gnas su rig pa 'dzin pa la sbrang rtsi dang pi pi ling gi sbyin sreg byas na thams cad 'dus par 'gyur zhing dus thams cad du rjes su dran pa tsam gyis rang gi bka' lung sgrub par byed do/ /shing gi grib mas shing gzhan la ma phog pa ni shing gcig go/ /shing gcig gi drung du rjes su dran pas mchod rten byas shing 'bum bzlas la mdun du a shwat+tha las byas pa'i rtse gsum pa byas la nyin mtshan smyung bar 'dug ste/ nya la dris bskus shing ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas ji srid 'bar bar gyur gyi bar du mtshan rangs pa bsgrub pa byas na gdul dka' ba 'dul bar byed pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de gling bzhi pa'i lha'i

phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag por 'gyur ro/ /sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la bzlas pa 'bum byas la nya la 'khor lo'i phyag mtshan nam rdo rje'i phyag mtshan nam rgyal mtshan blangs nas ji srid 'phur ba de srid bzlas na des kun du 'gro ba'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /chu bor zhugs te bzlas pa 'bum byas nas sa las byas pa'i mchod rten gyi rtsar nya la sogs pa'i nyin zhag la ji skad du bshad pa'i gnas su cho ga snga ma bzhin lag pas nor bu blangs te ji srid 'bar bar gyur pa de srid bzlas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'chang ba'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /yang de nyid lag pas blangs te bzlas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bur 'gyur ro/ /zangs ma'i bum pa la cho ga 'di nyid kyis bsgrub pa byas na bum pa gang bar 'gyur ro/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing lcags kyi rdo rje lag par blangs te/ ji srid 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi smra bar bya ba ston par byed pa de srid bzlas pas chos gang nyan par 'dod pa de mngon par ston par 'gyur ro/ /de'i steng du bsgrubs na 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /'bar bar gyur pas lag na rdo rje rdo rje'i rigs su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje ji lta ba bzhin du ral gri dang 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang glegs bam lag pas blangs te bsgrubs pas rdo rje'i rigs su 'jug par 'gyur zhing thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu'am gzhon nu ma legs par khrus byas te rgyan gyis brgyan pa la sngon du bsnyen pa byas la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas te nyin mtshan smyung bas mchod rten nam lugs sku 'am glegs bam mam bris sku 'am gzhan dag gi mdun du ku sha'i gcal bkram pa la 'dug nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la thal mo sbyar ba byas nas gsol ba btab la/ de nas tsan+dan nam ga bur ram gu gul lam du ru skas du ba med pa'i me mdag la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de dag med na skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste lag pas de dag bzung la ji srid gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas pas rab tu 'bar zhing 'phur bar 'gyur ro/ /lag pas blangs na de dag dang bcas

par rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /bud med legs par khrus byas shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa la ji srid skyes par gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /dur khrod du bris pa'am shing ngam sa las byas pa'i seng ge la ji srid 'gro bar gyur pa de srid bzlas pas de la zhon zhing gang du 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyin re rtag tu bzlas na gang du 'gro ba'i sa phyogs de bsrung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyin mtshan du sgrub pa byed na ji srid zhag lnga'am drug gam brgyad dam lhag ma'i zla ba phyed kyi nang du yar 'phags par 'gyur zhing lha rnams las kyang rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de la zhon na gang du 'dod pa der 'gro ba dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rta'am glang po che'am khyu mchog gam ma he'am ra skyes sam lug gam ri dgas la bzlas na de dag thams cad nyid gang du ji srid 'dod pa de srid du 'gro ba dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /me tog gis rab tu gtor ba'i dkyil 'khor la dur khrod kyi shing la me sbar la mar dang yungs kar gyis sbyin sreg byas na zla ba phyed kyi nang du nges par mkha' la 'phur bar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod ji lta ba de bzhin du ri bo la sogs pa la yang gcig pu dben par 'dug ste bsgrub pa'am dad pa la sogs pa bya la bsgrub pa'am cho ga 'di nyid kyis shing khri'am mchil lham la sogs pa la yang yid la 'dod pas cho ga bzhin du bsgrub par bya'o/ /shing mya ngan med kyi yal ga la 'jus nas ji srid nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang mi snang bar 'gyur ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du shing a shwat+tha dang n+ya gro dha dang nā ga puṣ+pa'i shing dang shing til ka dang a mra dang dur khrod kyi shing la 'dzegs te ji srid mi snang bar 'gro ba de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar mi snang bar gyur pas lo stong phrag brgyar 'tsho bar yang 'gyur zhing khru gang tsam gyis sa la ma reg par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod snyoms kyi 'tsho bas dur khrod du ji srid du mi snang bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /dur khrod du zhag lnga 'dug ste bzlas pa byas nas phyis de nyid du sa'i rang bzhin gyi mchod rten byas nas der me tog gi dkyil 'khor byas te/ thal ba

lag pa'i kha sbyar du bcug ste/ ji srid du ba 'thul ba de srid du bzlas pa byas nas des mdzub ris gsum byas pas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ma ta la'i rtsa bskam po phye mar byas te dur khrod du me tog gis mngon par gtor ba'i dkyil 'khor byas la lag pa kha sbyor ram kham por kha sbyor du bcug ste ji srid du ba 'thul ba de srid du bzlas pa byas la des mig la bskus na mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 'gro na puṣ+pa dad a ti pa lā dang / in+d+ra ba ru ni rnams kyi rtsa ba'am/ shu dag gam/ a pa rā tsi ta 'am/ a pa ra ti ni'am/ pad+ma'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba'am/ daṇ+ḍot+pa la'am/ ut+pa la'i me tog gam/ mi'i sha'am/ rma bya'i sha'am/ tsha ba gsum mam/ ra dza pa ta'am/ spos dkar po'am gzhan dag phye mar byas te/ kham phor kha sbyar ram lag pa kha sbyor du bcug ste ji srid du ba 'thul ba de srid du bzlas pa des mig la bskus na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod du sbrang rtsi la lan stong mngon par bsngags te mig la bskus nam mthong ba thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dgon par mchod rten gyi logs la shing rta bris la ji srid zla ba phyed kyi nang du 'gul bar 'gyur ba de srid nyin mtshan bzlas la de la zhon na kun du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ba bla blangs te dben pa'i mchod rten nam dgon pa'am ri la sogs ba la ji srid dngos grub gsum grub par gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gi wang dang mig sman la sogs pa la bsgrub par bya'o/ /dge slong gis rtag tu lhung bzed dang chos gos dang 'khar gsil la sogs pa blangs la bzlas pa bya zhing / 'jog pa na bsrung pa byas te gzhag par bya'o/ /de lta bu la sogs pa'i las su bya ba byed pa na yid la 'dod pa'i cho gas bsgrub pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rtog pa'i cho gas bsgrubs na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po 'di 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /thogs pa med pa don yod pa'i yid la 'dod pa'i cho gas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bsgrub par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa'i de

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di ltar bdag por khas blangs nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / dmigs pa dang / bzlas pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpar bcas pa rjes su dran zhing bzlas pa goms par bya'o/ /gal te skyil krung ma bshig par mtshan mo gcig pur ri la sogs pa dri zhim pa dben pa na dben par 'dug ste/ bzlas pa byed na nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyi tshe bsnyen pa ma byas par yang rig pa 'dzin pa nges par mtshan gcig gis 'grub bo/ /tsog pur 'dug nas byas na gdon mi za bar zla ba phyed kyi nang du lus yongs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /dkyil 'khor me tog la sogs pas mngon par gtor bar byas la/ mchod rten la mngon par phyogs pa'am/ lugs sku la mngon du phyogs pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag 'bul zhing stong phrag brgyad bzlas na dam pa'i chos spong ba dang 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams spong bar byed do/ /chu bo'i ngogs su mchod rten byas la chu bo de nyid du ske ba nub tsamadu zhugs te bzlas na las kyi sgrib pa zad par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mchod rten la skor ba byed cing stong phrag brgyad bzlas na sdig pha las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dben par mig btsums te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs nas/ ji srid mig btsums pa de kho nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid kyis mthong bar 'gyur ba de srid du bzlas pa byas na/ sdig pa'i las kyi sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /mi smra bar stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas na dkyil 'khor thams cad du rab tu zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /'dis dam tshig thams cad kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par 'tshe ba la mar dang yungs kar gyi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nad pa rnams kyi don du ni mar dang sbrang rtsis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /khros pa rnams kyi don du sbrang rtsi'o/ /rgyal po 'dren par byed pa la ni yungs kar til mar la sbags nas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /g.yul 'gyedapal ni 'od ma'i tsher ma'am 'chi ba la ma da na'i tsher ma'am arga'i me tog gam du dur ga'i me tog yungs kar gyi mar la

sbags pas sbyin sreg byas na 'chi ba rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /mu tsu kun+dha'i phur bu ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du spas na mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang sngags phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po thams cad bris te lcags kyi phur bus btab na rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad dang ma dad pa dang gnod pa byed pa phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /a sho ka'i pur bus lam po che'i bzhi mdor brkos na gdon chen po rengs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig pa la sogs pa'i rims thams cad la skud pa'am bdug spos dri zhim po rnams kyis mgo btums la rang la bdugs na sel bar byed cing lhas bstan nas smra bar byed do/ /de bzhin du sbyin sreg gang yin pa des kyang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa med par byed do/ /zla ba gzas zin pa na zangs ma'am lcags sam gser ram dngul gyi snod du bcug pa'i mar la ji srid dngos grub gsum thob par gyur pa de srid du bzlas la/ de 'thungs na thos pa 'dzin pa'am rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gzas zin pa na ba bla shing mya ngan med kyi lo ma la bzhag ste/ dgon pa'i mchod rten nam ri bo'i mchod rten gyi rtsar dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor ba byas shing ji srid grub pa gsum thob par gyur pa de srid du bzlas na 'bar bar gyur nas rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ba bla la ji lta ba de bzhin du lig bu mig dang ldong ros la sogs pa la zla ba gzas zin pa'am nyi ma gzas zin pa na bsgrub par bya'o/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyod yul la 'jug par 'gyur ba 'am rten 'pho bar 'dod pa'am rgal bar 'dod pa'am sems can rnams dang skye bo sdug bsngal ba rnams 'khor ba las yongs su srung bar byed 'dod pa'am bdag nyid mthong ba'i chos nyid la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la nges par sbyor bar 'dod pa'am gsal por snang ba la gzhan dag yang dag par sbyor bar 'dod pa'am/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las legs so zhes bya ba'i rnam pa rab tu bsgrags pa myur du rnyed par 'dod pa'am/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la skye ba rnyed par 'dod pas sngags kyi

spyod pa'i sgo byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /thabs la mkhas pa 'dis kyang yongs su zin par bya ste/ smon lam rgya chen po bya ba dang sdig pa rnams so sor bshags pa dang dus gsum du 'byung ba'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang rjes su yi rang ba yang sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyu nyid du rab tu sbyor bar gyur cig ces de ltar bsngo 'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dmigs shing sems can gyi don 'byung bar gyur cig ces dang po'i tshig tu brjod pa'am/ rjes su bsams pa'am/ dmigs nas bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab cing sems can gyi don 'di 'byung bar gyur cig ces dang po tshig tu brjod pa'am rnam par bsams te bzlas pa bya'o/ /dben pa'i sa phyogs su 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa shin tu rgya chen po'i mdo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyu la rab tu 'jug pa klog pa nyid dang sems pa nyid dang mchod pa nyid tshes gcig nas brtsams te zla ba gcig gi bar du bya'o/ /de nas nya la mchod pa byas te mtshan thog thag tu bzlas pa byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon zhing mgo bo la phyag gis byugs te/ 'di skad du skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so zhes gsung bar 'gyur te/ de la sogs pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rnyed par 'gyur zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rjes su zhugs nas mngon par shes pa lnga thob par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar sems can rnams 'tshang rgya pa'ibari rgyur gyur cig ces rnam par bsams la bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi nad rnams rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang sdug bsngal gyis nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ces de ltar bzlas par bya'o/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba rnams la dro ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / tsha ba'i dmyal ba rnams la grang ba nyid 'byung bar gyur cig ces bzlas par bya'o/ /dud 'gro

rnams gcig la gcig za ba rnams med par gyur cig ces bzlas par bya'o/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad du sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba thams cad med par gyur cig /bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig /yi dgas rnams la bza' ba dang btung ba 'byung bar gyur cig ces de ltar zang zing med pa'i sems can thams cad la longs spyod pa 'byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba rab tu 'phel ba'i shugs 'byung bar gyur cig /bde ba dang yid bde ba de dag rnams la 'byung bar gyur cig /dad pa dang dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa dang rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i shugs 'byung bar gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sa la sems can so sor gnas par gyur cig ces bya ba la sogs pa dang gzhan yang sems can la phan pa'i rgyur dmigs te sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /mdor na 'khor bar gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa rab tu spang ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bzlas pas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs dang smon lam gyi stobs dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis go ra mis ji lta bzhin du sems can gyi khams su sems can gyi don gyi khyad par chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen par 'gyur te mos pa rgya che ba dang dad pas byang chub mngon par 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu de la yang dad par bya'o/ /de la 'di'i dpe bstan pa ni 'di lta ste/ yang 'dod pa'i khams na dbang phyug ces bya ba yod de/ 'dod pa skyed par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig pas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu 'dod pas rgyal bar byed cing 'dod pa'i longs spyod yongs su longs spyod pa yang / yang dag par ston par byed do/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa
